name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: I have an opponent
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BOB CASEY FOR SENATE INC
body:
The MAGA Republican machine couldn’t find a single Republican in Massachusetts to run against me — so they brought in someone from Rhode Island.
It’s official, Peter: John Deaton, a well-funded Republican, has launched a campaign to run against me for Senate in Massachusetts.
Apparently, the MAGA Republican machine couldn’t find a single Republican in Massachusetts to run against me — so they brought in someone from Rhode Island who will have the backing of the GOP and special interest groups.
This much is clear: We’re up against national Republicans who are desperate to take back the Senate and pass Trump’s agenda. We’re up against their rich buddies who are trying to stop us from taxing the wealthy, regulating big banks, and making our government work for working people.
[**It’s going to take a strong grassroots movement to compete and win. Can you please split a donation of $5 or anything you can to support my re-election campaign and Bob Casey's work? We need to respond to my opponent’s campaign launch with the strongest amount of grassroots donations to protect our Senate majority.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240310-3?refcode=em20240310-3&refcode2=2272_552475_0EwgsN&akid=2272%2E552475%2E0EwgsN)
**[Donate Now ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240310-3?refcode=em20240310-3&refcode2=2272_552475_0EwgsN&akid=2272%2E552475%2E0EwgsN)**
I’m proud of the progress we’ve accomplished for Massachusetts families so far — like lowering the cost of hearing aids, passing a new tax on massive corporations that were paying $0 in taxes, getting student loan debt canceled, securing billions in funding for projects like an electric bus fleet and infrastructure repairs, and so much more.
But there’s plenty more to do for working people in Massachusetts and across the country. We’ve got to bring down the cost of housing. Put child care within reach for all working parents. Protect our Commonwealth from the climate crisis. Take power away from powerful interests like Big Pharma, Big Oil, and big banks and put it in the hands of working people — which means we need to root corruption out of Washington. And I’ve got the most sweeping set of anti-corruption plans since Watergate.
**This election is about who our government works for — and it’s about defending our democracy and our basic freedoms. I’m fighting to keep our Senate majority because if Republicans win any more power, they’ll restrict abortion access _everywhere_ , even in blue states that have passed abortion protections — like Massachusetts. They’ll threaten voting rights, LGBTQIA+ rights, Social Security, Medicare, and the Affordable Care Act — they’ll reward the rich and powerful, and embolden an extremist base across the country. **
So I’m staying in this fight to stop MAGA extremism, continue standing up to powerful special interests, and make real change for working people. Are you with me?
[**Please respond to my opponent’s announcement with a donation of $5 or anything you can to support this campaign and Bob Casey. Grassroots supporters like you have helped defeat the GOP and special interests in the past, and I need your support again as we take on this new fight.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240310-3?refcode=em20240310-3&refcode2=2272_552475_0EwgsN&akid=2272%2E552475%2E0EwgsN)
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth

Dear Friend,

On Wednesday, Governor Carney delivered his final State of the State Address. The Governor used it as an opportunity to highlight many of the accomplishments of the past seven years and to talk about the work still left to do. He talked about the progress being made across Delaware, with a focus on significant improvements in the city of Wilmington.

The Carney administration has championed state investments in public safety and gun violence prevention, in affordable housing and in our public schools. These investments, which include the Maurice Prichett, Sr. Academy, the first new school built in Wilmington in over a half century, have made Wilmington a better place to live and raise a family.

The Governor ended his speech by saying he intends serve out his term strongly and to leave it all out on the field , as the sports expression goes. As we continue to build this campaign for Mayor, we know that it will take all of Team Carney to run this race through the finish line. And we will need the help of lots of contributors and volunteers. Already, we’ve seen an outpouring of support, but we still have a lot of work to do and we need your help.

The maximum contribution is $600. body:
Your weekly rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
Heidi Ganahl introduces the Rocky Mountain Voice, a new conservative news media platform for Coloradans to be the VOICE of your VALUES.
| | [ ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
| **March 10, 2024**
# **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST**
### By Heidi Ganahl
---
| Good evening, Welcome to this edition of the Sunday News Digest, where we delve into the most significant news stories of the week. In the realm of politics, [Nikki Haley's decision to suspend her presidential campaign](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) has stirred conversation about the future direction of the Republican Party. Haley's call for former President Donald Trump to earn support from a broader spectrum of Republicans underscores the ongoing debate within the party. Meanwhile, in Colorado, tensions rise as House Republicans push for the [impeachment of Secretary of State Jena Griswold](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Accusations of partisan bias and lack of transparency have fueled calls for action, highlighting the divisive nature of state politics. Turning to law enforcement, the [National Sheriffs’ Association has voiced frustration over President Biden's State of the Union address](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). The omission of law enforcement recognition and concerns about border security have raised questions about the administration's priorities. In a separate development, a troubling investigation reveals [manipulation of DNA evidence by a former forensic scientist at the Colorado Bureau of Investigation](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). The revelation has cast doubt on hundreds of criminal cases, prompting a reevaluation of the criminal justice system's integrity. As we navigate these complex issues, it's crucial to stay informed and engaged with the latest developments. Join us next week for another edition of the Sunday News Digest, where we'll continue to provide insights into the stories shaping our world. Have a great week, Heidi Ganahl
---
|
# FEATURED
---
[**See how each of Colorado's counties voted:** **Trump wins 57 of Colorado’s 64 counties in Super Tuesday rout of Haley**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) By Brian Porter, Rocky Mountain Voice Editor & Publisher
| [ ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
On Super Tuesday in Colorado, former President Donald Trump secured broad support from Republicans across the state, winning 57 of the 64 counties with over 63% of the vote. Nikki Haley, his main opponent, won only seven counties. Trump's strongest support came from Eastern Colorado, where he garnered over 80% support in many counties. In contrast, Haley performed best in Denver, Boulder, and Pitkin counties. Despite these victories, two counties did not give either candidate a majority, indicating some division within the Republican electorate. Overall, voter turnout was significant, with over 1.3 million voters participating in the primary elections, representing 36% of all registered voters in the state.
| [ READ MORE ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
# STATE
**[Tracking the no good, terrible, really bad bills](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Another week has passed in the Colorado Legislature, and that means more bad bills, [Kevin Lundberg writes](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in his weekly report. There are 544 bills to have been introduced. The inevitable list of really bad bills, and some good ones (that are probably destined to a party-line defeat) is growing at a very fast pace. Lundberg attempts to ease the madness in his report of the [list of “Significant Bills for 2024”](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
[**WATCH: All Veterans Honor Guard honored at Colorado Capitol**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [KDVR-TV FOX 31](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) It was a super Tuesday for the men and women of the All Veterans Honor Guard at the Colorado Capitol. But, it had nothing to do with voting. “We are an organization of veterans and volunteers that provides honors for our departing veterans at Fort Logan National Cemetery,” said Maury Smith, All Veterans Honor Guard commander.
[**Colorado House Democrats kill proposal pushing for tougher approach to fentanyl crisis**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Michael Fiore, the outreach coordinator for Voices for Awareness and Project Facing Fentanyl, remembered selling drugs to support his addiction and skating through the system before getting clean — after serving a prison term in New York.
| [ READ MORE STATE NEWS ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
# NATIONAL
**[‘Anytime, Anywhere, Anyplace’: Trump issues debate challenge to Biden](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [EPOCH TIMES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**Former President Donald Trump challenged President Joe Biden to debate him on key issues facing the nation. “It is important, for the good of our country, that Joe Biden and I debate issues that are so vital to America, and the American people. Therefore, I am calling for debates, anytime, anywhere, anyplace!”
**[Republicans decry arrest of Gold Star father for heckling Biden at State of the Union](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [WASHINGTON EXAMINER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**GOP lawmakers are defending the Gold Star father arrested by U.S. Capitol Police on Thursday for heckling President Joe Biden during his State of the Union address.
**[State of the Union: Biden lied 30 times during address to Congress](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE FEDERALIST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) President Biden has been known to tell some pretty outrageous lies throughout his political career. So, it came as no surprise when Ol’ Sleepy Joe spewed out more than a few whoppers during his State of the Union address on Thursday.

name: Patti Reilly
subject: Washington D.C. betrayed my son
body:
Our nightmare started in October of 2020.

Dear Friend,

I know you and I have never met. But I'm praying that you'll help me save my son, Officer Terence Sutton.

This is a picture of Terence and me at a dinner celebrating his graduation from the Police Academy.
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z8betvqnl3cnsfl92crnmau4cc13cp4o64p07pmg_rp22sh2s8i6ep30chim8oj1c1h2bs)
I was so proud that night. But I was also terrified.

Terence was going to be patrolling the streets of Washington, DC, where crime is sky-high and politicians side with criminals over cops. But never in my wildest imagination could I have predicted that my son would be _wrongfully_ _convicted_ _of_ _murder_ **- murder of a criminal my son didn't even touch.**

The story is so shocking that if it didn't happen to my son, _I wouldn 't even believe it._ **[And I'm praying you will help me save my son](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z4m65m78lvedvhrceh0runv8ppol9aavgpi8ei40_rp22sh2s8i6ep30chim8oj1c1h2bs)** - **but first, let me explain what happened.**

Our nightmare started in October of 2020.

Terence was sitting in his patrol car when he received a report that a known gang member, Karon Hylton-Brown, was seen entering a rival gang's territory.

Karon was a violent criminal with a rap sheet a mile long - including drugs, illegal gun possession, and assaults. Earlier that day, he had been seen arguing with a rival gang member who owed him money. Terence and other officers were concerned Karon was planning to get revenge.

So when Terence saw him illegally driving a motorized scooter on the sidewalk without a helmet, he tried to pull Karon over to talk. Instead, Karon took off on the scooter.

Terence watched as Karon sped through traffic, weaving in and out of cars and blowing past red lights and stop signs.

My son knew Karon was putting others at risk, so for 3 minutes he slowly and carefully followed behind in his patrol car.

And then it happened.

Karon veered into an alleyway, drove out the other side without looking and slammed into a passing car.

After several days in the hospital, Karon died from his injuries. And here's where the story takes a shocking turn...

Because Karon was black, and the incident happened just four months after George Floyd's death, the anti-police mob went into frenzy.

They blamed Terence for the accident and smeared him as a racist.

There were protests and even riots. The mob threw rocks at officers, smashed store windows, and set fires.

Anti-police politicians piled on too. Without any evidence, they demanded my son be charged even though he did nothing to cause Karon's death.

The pressure campaign worked, and prosecutors charged my son with _**Second-Degree Murder.**_

When Terence called to tell me about the charges, I was in disbelief. Any sane person could see that Karon's death, while tragic, was no one's fault but his own.

_He_ chose to run from the cops.

_He_ chose to not wear a helmet.

_He_ chose to speed through that alley without looking where he was going.

So, when I learned that Terence could be sentenced to **_sixty_ _years_** in prison for Karon's death, my head started spinning. And it only got worse when the trial began.

You see, the judge refused to allow Terence's legal team to present all of the facts in his defense.

The jury never got to hear that Karon was a known member of a violent gang...

They never got to hear that he was wearing an ankle monitor because of a violent assault he had committed just weeks before...

They never got to hear that he had drugs and thousands of dollars in cash strapped to his leg...

And they never got to hear about the drugs in Karon's system at the time of the crash.

Sitting in the courtroom, I couldn't believe my ears when the jury filed out and declared Terence _**" guilty."**_

He's currently awaiting sentencing.

Now you understand why I'm so heartbroken. The injustice is almost too much to bear.

My son was well-respected by the community he served. He trained many Rookies and set a good example for all of them.

He was even awarded Officer of the Year!

And at the same time the bleeding-heart DC politicians are letting shoplifters, carjackers, and drug dealers walk away scot-free...

...they're trying to put my son - a decorated officer who has received 60 awards and commendations - away for 60 years for something he _didn 't_ _do._

I had almost lost hope, but then we learned about the **Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund** -or LELDF for short.

If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know they're a national group fighting on behalf of wrongly-accused police officers like Terence. LELDF has helped dozens of innocent cops - and their families - at their lowest moments. And when I got the call from their president, Jason Johnson, I was at my lowest moment.

Not only did LELDF decide to help my son get the legal defense he deserves. They're also raising money to pay for the best attorneys and expert witnesses for Terence.

So I have to ask you one of the toughest questions I've ever asked anyone:

**[Will you help my son Terence fight the unjust charges against him by donating to LELDF?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z55oqckrd44fgvljsk2kund78jb0esao0cv6rdi8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30chim8oj1c1h2bs)**

To fund his defense, Terence had to sell his home, his car, his beloved motorcycle, and most of his personal belongings. Everything he owns now fits in just nine small boxes. He has almost nothing left.

If I had anywhere else to turn, I wouldn't be so bold as to ask for your help.

But I already lost my husband. He was a police officer too, and he was so proud that Terence followed in his footsteps. And it makes me cry when I think of how he would feel about what Terence is being put through right now.

I simply can't bear the thought of having another family member ripped away from me.

**[So if you are at all able, would you consider following this link to make a tax-deductible donation to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund to help my Terence?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z7kslkpq6l28hhu1gp49kn3pbh0qo8ktvnllhplg_rp22sh2s8i6ep30chim8oj1c1h2bs)**

**Any amount - $35, $50, $100, or even $500 or more - will help.**

And because LELDF is a non-profit organization, your gift is completely tax-deductible. But whatever you can afford to give, I ask that you rush it back quickly.

Terence's team is currently looking at every available option to keep his case alive.

**[And you and your $35 contribution could make the difference in Terence being acquitted or spending the next 60 years behind bars.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zoiv3bs7mrkm9lltk5727gtomrortukdqu07ri4o_rp22sh2s8i6ep30chim8oj1c1h2bs)**

Right now, Terence can only rely on the good nature and generosity of kind neighbors like you.

Thank you for taking the time to read my letter today.

And thank you - in advance - for doing what you can to help all the wrongly-accused officers LELDF is working with. Like Terence.

Sincerely,

Patti Reilly

P.S. I know a few kind words from someone like you will help lift Terence's spirits. This guilty verdict has been so devastating for him. **[So if you choose to make a $35 gift to LELDF, would you also please include a little note-maybe a prayer?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z01abegbk3qcg05nbgevmh0tp94f9dntn0m5fr1g_rp22sh2s8i6ep30chim8oj1c1h2bs)** There's a field on the page for you to do this. Thank you -from the bottom of my heart.
--------

_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we 're defending, please visit **www.PoliceDefense.org**. And remember -Blue Lives Matter!_

| SB 603 Priority Treatment Jailed Pregnant and Addicted Women Passes the House Appropriations Committee
---
|
---
| My bill SB 603, which will give incarcerated pregnant women preferential treatment for drug rehab programs, is now on the governors desk. I have visited the women's jail in Goochland County and I've heard reports around the district about the challenges faced by pregnant women in jail to attend drug rehab programs. Incarcerated pregnant women (those held in federal or state prisons, jails, or juvenile detention facilities) make up one of the most vulnerable segments of society, with higher rates of mental illness, drug addiction, and histories of trauma than incarcerated men. This bill will create a work group to find answers on how to help rehabilitate young and not so young women with the triple threat of being incarcerated, being pregnant, and being addicted.

| Dear Peter,
I am back in the fight against Communist China. We were extremely successful in eliminating the Chinese Communist Party's Confucius Institutes from our college campuses. Now we must tackle another, even bigger issue that is impacting every American family.
It is time for the United States to take back the minds of its youth. Minds that have been poisoned by the Communist Party of China via its propaganda machine; TikTok.
President Xi Jinping himself stated: "Many people, especially young people, do not read mainstream media and get most of their information from the internet. We must face up to this fact, increase investment, and seize the initiative on this battlefield of public opinion as soon as possible." The initiative the Chinese Party funded is TikTok.
Yintao Yu, former head of US engineering for ByteDance (parent company of TikTok), in a legal filing and testimony last year stated that TikTok "enabled a special committee of Chinese Communist Party members stationed at the company to view all data collected by ByteDance/TikTok including those of U.S. users....and it was recently used to keep tabs on Hong Kong protesters and civil rights activists by monitoring their locations and devices, their network information, SIM card identifications, IP addresses and communications."
This week, thanks to the courage and bipartisanship of Chairman Mike Gallagher and Congressman Raja Krishnamoorthi there is now a bill being moved in Congress that would force TikTok to either sell to an American company, or face closure in the U.S. and its territories. The bill has already passed the Energy and Commerce Committee in a UNANIMOUS vote, and Joe Biden's administration has endorsed it.
However, the work is far from complete. TikTok has one of the strongest lobbying armies in Washington, DC. According to Chairman Gallagher: "TikTok is digital fentanyl, addicting our kids, and just like actual fentanyl, it ultimately goes back to the Chinese Communist Party. ... Oh, and oh, by the way, TikTok is using the swamp against us. They're hiring an army of lobbyists, including former Congressmen, Senators, 31 former high-level congressional staffers, in order to do their bidding."
We must fight fire with fire. * We will deploy teams of advocates in both the House and the Senate to educate members of Congress and their staff, dropping off fact sheet packets.
* We will help to combat the false pro-TikTok narratives in the press and social media.
* We will organize calling efforts for citizens to tell their members of Congress to support HR7521 and help push it through the United States Senate.

TikTok is already trying to influence the legislation by sending out millions of messages to American teenagers to contact their Congressman to defeat this bipartisan effort.

# MONDAY, MARCH 11, 2024
---|---
**Good Morning**! On this date in 1892, the first public game of basketball was played in Springfield, Mass., at the YMCA where the game had been invented by James Naismith a few months earlier. ([See Photos](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz72OqzAQQOGnsbsg_ww4LlzcBt0m225pDXgcZmMwAitR3n61W295miN9n7d4Qy683T9wpdByjTg3flK0F60vBiLIFDKRISspaKeVHkBpI5dwTQnmQVmXCa13GTzmaQLvEimF0EsORhlQVmvl-8FeO9fDjFfrQbnezdoLUJS41aP7qry1hXJ51ycd3VxXWcLS2n4K-0-YUZiRtu7FD94pMXb1uAsz_rQw438-Wz3eseY44fmgNmEp8ghpf3EpfA5OgLqvyOV33P5kfgcAAP__VRdUIA)) Welcome to _The Flyover's_ anniversary week! We sent our first edition to a few friends and family members on March 15, 2023, and this morning we're writing to over 620,000 of you. It's a little overwhelming, to be honest--what a year! Invest in the future of the smart home industry! | Biden Speech Doesn't Move Approval Ratings In the released since the State of the Union address, President Biden's approval ratings remain largely unchanged: Two-thirds of Americans disapprove of his handling of the border, the economy, and the Gaza war. In the realm of finance, the clash between traditional fiat currencies and emerging cryptocurrencies, particularly Bitcoin, has sparked vigorous debates. While the US dollar has long been regarded as the global reserve currency, Bitcoin presents a compelling case as a superior alternative. Let's delve into why Bitcoin stands out as a beacon of financial innovation, eclipsing the conventional US dollar in various aspects.

In a world where digital currencies are becoming increasingly prevalent, Bitcoin stands out as a revolutionary force challenging the traditional financial landscape. But why would anyone prefer Bitcoin over the US dollar? Let's break it down in everyday language.
1. **Decentralization and Control** : When you think about your dollars, you know they're controlled by banks and governments. They can freeze your account or control the flow of money. Bitcoin, on the other hand, operates on a decentralized network. No one entity controls it. It's like a currency created by the people, for the people.
2. **Transparency** : Ever wondered where your dollars go once you deposit them in a bank? With Bitcoin, every transaction is recorded on a public ledger called the blockchain. It's like a digital paper trail that anyone can access. This transparency ensures accountability and reduces the chances of fraud or corruption.
3. **Lower Transaction Fees** : Sending money internationally can be a hassle with traditional banks. They charge hefty fees and it can take days for the transaction to go through. Bitcoin transactions, however, are much faster and often come with lower fees. Plus, you can send money anywhere in the world in a matter of minutes, without needing approval from the government.
4. **Inflation Resistance** : The value of your dollars can fluctuate due to inflation. Ever noticed how prices seem to keep going up? Bitcoin, on the other hand, has a fixed supply. There will only ever be 21 million bitcoins in existence, making it resistant to inflation. This means your purchasing power remains more stable over time.
5. **Accessibility** : Not everyone has access to traditional banking services. In some parts of the world, people don't have bank accounts or struggle with high fees. Bitcoin provides a way for anyone with an internet connection to participate in the global economy. All you need is a smartphone or computer.
6. **Privacy** : When you make a purchase with your credit card, the bank knows exactly what you bought and where. Bitcoin transactions are pseudonymous, meaning they're not directly tied to your identity. While the transactions are public, your personal information remains private unless you choose to disclose it.
7. **Innovative Technology** : Bitcoin is built on blockchain technology, which has the potential to revolutionize industries beyond finance. It enables secure, transparent, and tamper-proof record-keeping, with applications ranging from supply chain management to voting systems.
8. **Global Acceptance** : While the US dollar is widely accepted, it's not the same everywhere. Bitcoin, on the other hand, is borderless. It doesn't matter if you're in the United States, China, or Kenya - Bitcoin is accepted globally. This makes it ideal for international trade and remittances.
9. **Ownership and Control** : With dollars, you rely on banks to keep your money safe. But what if the bank goes under or freezes your account? With Bitcoin, you have full control over your funds. As long as you keep your private keys secure, no one can seize your assets.
10. **Future Potential** : Bitcoin is still in its early stages. As more people adopt it and technology evolves, its potential could be limitless. Some experts believe it could become the currency of the future, transcending borders and empowering individuals in ways we can't even imagine.

In conclusion, while the US dollar has served us for decades, Bitcoin offers a glimpse into a more decentralized, transparent, and accessible financial system. It's not without its challenges, but its potential to reshape the world of finance is undeniable. Whether you're a skeptic or a believer, Bitcoin is certainly worth paying attention to in the ever-changing landscape of money.

Hello Peter, **Happy Women’s History Month!** 🦸♀️This month is all about celebrating the countless contributions women have made throughout U.S. history. Pennsylvania has had some trailblazing women in the news over the past few years: 🔹 **Joanna McClinton** was recently sworn in as the first female speaker of the Pennsylvania House.
🔹 **Sara Innamorato** became Allegheny County's first female chief executive.

| Friend,
I've said it before and I'll say it again:
The 2024 election cycle is going to be America's first real up-close encounter with AI in a bad way.
I'm leading the charge to ensure AI is properly controlled and managed - but I want you by my side.
We need to stop:
1. Deepfakes of Politicians
2. Fake robocalls scamming our friends and families
3. Causing harm to vulnerable women and men
4. And even propaganda news stories

But now I need to know where you stand.

The Governor has 30 Days to Act
| | | |
THE VIRGINIA GENERAL ASSEMBLY ADJOURNED SATURDAY
GOVERNOR YOUNGKIN HAS 30 DAYS TO ACT
APRIL 8 DEADLINE
---
---
| Friends, Here is an updated list of actions Governor Youngkin has taken on bills that are currently on his desk. Please see the list below of bills vetoed, signed into law or recommendations made by the Governor.
In case you missed it, on Saturday, March 9 at 5:10 pm, the Virginia General Assembly adjourned Sine Die, after 3 hours of debating and voting on the last remaining bills in conference.
Among the 2,200 bills that passed both of the Democrat controlled chambers, was the 2024-2026 biennial budget. Now the bills are on the Governor's desk waiting for action. Governor Youngkin only has 30 days, April 8, to amend, veto or sign those bills into law.
Governor Youngkin has already signed 64 bills into law, amended 12 bills and vetoed 8 of the 84 bills of the "Seven Day" Legislation before the Friday, March 8 midnight deadline. You can review those bills [here](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001QexywSZsb5JUpAV-yqzKALp1y_jkNAPIPs_hw3DZ49-zDEYluecS4_ctChcSFkyH4_D7N4J3DacWxm5TCm6Pt0-fPSRjB4i_uvxamCK02R2XD-UQAY6zIrphcU83aqJ5b6f3D211szFIINJfHYrRLnXAuKjmRpyMoK2uukZHQ0WajXQns75fl6JQnnGQuZhaCwvNYRDAck6L87Mc9vensiVv8-oNXkRB_sJmTOGZ1Z7pjx15QVSBZA==&c=EftN4k75MH9Q5rcDpAGRg1RLTGLmJLQ4gMh0Rn0iqNm_t0IiDH9ZnQ==&ch=d3wkECBSA8TYYP2TGm2W4qHqKBL6QlVTylTdIwkEwPHBGKXlMirW5A==).
The General Assembly took no action Saturday on either the Governor's vetoes or the amendments. The legislature can override vetoes with a two-thirds majority, but with Democrats holding a narrow 51-49 edge over the GOP, they are unlikely to be able to muster the votes to do so.
On Saturday, the legislature passed its $188 billion biennial budget for fiscal years 2024-2026 by a margin of [62-37 in the House of Delegates](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001QexywSZsb5JUpAV-yqzKALp1y_jkNAPIPs_hw3DZ49-zDEYluecS4_ctChcSFkyHmv6QM4sUnpjZlmGQeNJDur5sJ1E4KER4G2LTW1s_ILGXjjkRahJnyooBWuLSfFd5guSeh6piPsrXuB1-5fZMOLeP8SJx4MZkTuffJsssvXPUqcloml1PJobzxztXiqzHTxWvKCTj2konJo1yVoAJVQ==&c=EftN4k75MH9Q5rcDpAGRg1RLTGLmJLQ4gMh0Rn0iqNm_t0IiDH9ZnQ==&ch=d3wkECBSA8TYYP2TGm2W4qHqKBL6QlVTylTdIwkEwPHBGKXlMirW5A==) and [24-14 in the Senate.](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001QexywSZsb5JUpAV-yqzKALp1y_jkNAPIPs_hw3DZ49-zDEYluecS4_ctChcSFkyHTttKUCmSzzbDLr-kznpaw_wQFXPWix_o7LEFIdbih5T_TKeVBU-V-mKKw5pW2rOuRd8xvzMT2o1yCWm4T54qDqOe7AdL8JlYNQGLOjdz0m01GkFTyhO-9Rn-4_qs-HTksMHL1WxMr23KO8sxqx-KWA==&c=EftN4k75MH9Q5rcDpAGRg1RLTGLmJLQ4gMh0Rn0iqNm_t0IiDH9ZnQ==&ch=d3wkECBSA8TYYP2TGm2W4qHqKBL6QlVTylTdIwkEwPHBGKXlMirW5A==)
The budget is set to take effect July 1, 2024. For a list of how each legislator voted on the budget you can click on the links above.
The budget includes more than $2.5 billion in new funding for K-12 public education, a 3% salary increase for teachers and state employees, $2.5 million for the proposed inland port in Washington County and $70 million in one-time general fund support to accelerate the Interstate 81 northbound lane widening project.
Missing from both the Democrat controlled House and Senate budgets are key pieces of Governor Youngkin's proposed tax plan.
That plan would have reduced personal income tax and raised the state sales tax. Youngkin also recommended adding a sales tax on digital goods like streaming services to make up for any shortfalls.
However, most of Youngkin's tax plan was removed , except for the proposed sales tax on digital goods.
Not happening Saturday was any further action on the arena deal. The proposal is expected to bring jobs and revenue to the state, but bills to create a state authority to issue bonds needed for the deal were never heard by the Senate, where Finance and Appropriations Chair Louise Lucas, D-Portsmouth, has opposed it. Nor did the General Assembly include the proposal in its budget.
Youngkin now has the option of sending down an amendment to the budget to include the arena proposal, but the legislature will have to approve that change when it reconvenes April 17 to finalize the state's spending plan and consider any other amendments or vetoes to other bills.
No discussion on the arena deal could happen before then, said Sen. Mamie Locke, D-Hampton, but the governor could call a special session to consider the arena proposal, a possibility she didn't rule out entirely.
"We'll see," said Locke. "Anything can happen."
Democrats' decision to exclude the arena from the budget the General Assembly approved Saturday is also expected to influence what happens with the bills the legislature sent to Youngkin that are still awaiting his review.
Below is a comprehensive list of bills that have failed in committee, bills that passed both houses, along with a list of actions on bills taken by the Governor thus far.
If you desire to get more information on one of the bills listed below just click the button below for each committee and the bill history and summary is listed.
The Virginia General Assembly will reconvene on Wednesday, April 17 for consideration of the Governor's amendments and vetoes. With only a one member majority in each house, it is unlikely that the Democrats will be able to override any of Governor Youngkin's vetoes.
Included in this weekly newsletter is a list of important dates for upcoming primaries and elections. Please mark your calendar.

clean_body: The Governor has 30 Days to Act | | | | THE VIRGINIA GENERAL ASSEMBLY ADJOURNED SATURDAY GOVERNOR YOUNGKIN HAS 30 DAYS TO ACT APRIL 8 DEADLINE | Friends, Here is an updated list of actions Governor Youngkin has taken on bills that are currently on his desk. Please see the list below of bills vetoed, signed into law or recommendations made by the Governor. In case you missed it, on Saturday, March 9 at 5:10 pm, the Virginia General Assembly adjourned Sine Die, after 3 hours of debating and voting on the last remaining bills in conference. Among the 2,200 bills that passed both of the Democrat controlled chambers, was the 2024-2026 biennial budget. Now the bills are on the Governor's desk waiting for action. Governor Youngkin only has 30 days, April 8, to amend, veto or sign those bills into law. Governor Youngkin has already signed 64 bills into law, amended 12 bills and vetoed 8 of the 84 bills of the "Seven Day" Legislation before the Friday, March 8 midnight deadline. You can review those bills ==. The General Assembly took no action Saturday on either the Governor's vetoes or the amendments. The legislature can override vetoes with a two-thirds majority, but with Democrats holding a narrow 51-49 edge over the GOP, they are unlikely to be able to muster the votes to do so. On Saturday, the legislature passed its $188 billion biennial budget for fiscal years 2024-2026 by a margin of == and == The budget is set to take effect July 1, 2024. For a list of how each legislator voted on the budget you can click on the links above. The budget includes more than $2.5 billion in new funding for K-12 public education, a 3% salary increase for teachers and state employees, $2.5 million for the proposed inland port in Washington County and $70 million in one-time general fund support to accelerate the Interstate 81 northbound lane widening project. Missing from both the Democrat controlled House and Senate budgets are key pieces of Governor Youngkin's proposed tax plan. That plan would have reduced personal income tax and raised the state sales tax. Youngkin also recommended adding a sales tax on digital goods like streaming services to make up for any shortfalls. However, most of Youngkin's tax plan was removed , except for the proposed sales tax on digital goods. Not happening Saturday was any further action on the arena deal. The proposal is expected to bring jobs and revenue to the state, but bills to create a state authority to issue bonds needed for the deal were never heard by the Senate, where Finance and Appropriations Chair Louise Lucas, D-Portsmouth, has opposed it. Nor did the General Assembly include the proposal in its budget. Youngkin now has the option of sending down an amendment to the budget to include the arena proposal, but the legislature will have to approve that change when it reconvenes April 17 to finalize the state's spending plan and consider any other amendments or vetoes to other bills. No discussion on the arena deal could happen before then, said Sen. Mamie Locke, D-Hampton, but the governor could call a special session to consider the arena proposal, a possibility she didn't rule out entirely. "We'll see," said Locke. "Anything can happen." Democrats' decision to exclude the arena from the budget the General Assembly approved Saturday is also expected to influence what happens with the bills the legislature sent to Youngkin that are still awaiting his review. Below is a comprehensive list of bills that have failed in committee, bills that passed both houses, along with a list of actions on bills taken by the Governor thus far. If you desire to get more information on one of the bills listed below just click the button below for each committee and the bill history and summary is listed. The Virginia General Assembly will reconvene on Wednesday, April 17 for consideration of the Governor's amendments and vetoes. With only a one member majority in each house, it is unlikely that the Democrats will be able to override any of Governor Youngkin's vetoes. Included in this weekly newsletter is a list of important dates for upcoming primaries and elections. Please mark your calendar. | Please also consider following me on == for my real time daily posts regarding votes on controversial and significant impact bills. Hope you find my daily and weekly newsletter along with my Facebook posts helpful in following the General Assembly. Peter — later this month, the Supreme Court will hear the mifepristone case aimed at banning the most commonly used abortion medication nationwide.
Josh Hawley and his corrupt family business made that case happen, in the same way they led the charge to overturn Roe v. Wade, and Hawley abused his power as Missouri’s U.S. Senator to do it all. **Please let me explain:**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44421?refcode=em20240311-5014&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5014%2E614464%2EqLCvo2)

In 2017, Matt Kacsmaryk was nominated to be a federal judge for the North Texas district court. His confirmation stalled for years due to bipartisan opposition over his bizarre obsession with controlling people’s bodies, an issue he was even caught lying about during his nomination process:
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44421?refcode=em20240311-5014&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=5014%2E614464%2EqLCvo2)
The next year, while his nomination languished in the Senate, Kacsmaryk made an investment in his future by becoming a campaign donor to Josh Hawley, a fellow member of the Federalist Society — a group of corporate activist lawyers with funders including Chevron, Google, and the Kochs.
**Once Hawley was sworn into the U.S. Senate in 2019, he decided to make Kacsmaryk, his campaign donor, a federal judge.** Hawley confirmed Kacsmaryk to the northern Texas district court, despite even more bipartisan opposition over Kacsmaryk’s Big Brother views on contraceptives and personal freedoms.
Flash forward to 2022, a lawsuit was filed in the northern Texas district court by activist lawyers seeking to ban an abortion pill that millions have used safely. _Abortion medication accounts for over half of all abortions._
**Josh Hawley’s wife led the suit. His donor was the judge.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44421?refcode=em20240311-5014&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=5014%2E614464%2EqLCvo2)

**In April 2022, Hawley’s donor judge ruled in favor of the suit led by Hawley’s wife, calling for a near-immediate ban on the abortion pill mifepristone in all 50 states.** This was the first time a judge has ever unilaterally tried to take a drug off the market against FDA objections.
Just days after Kacsmaryk’s ruling, Josh Hawley used his Senate office to submit an amicus brief demanding that the Supreme Court end a temporary injunction blocking the ruling (in his wife's lawsuit) by a judge (his campaign donor) to ban America's most commonly-used abortion medication.
**Now, that mifepristone case, which was decided by Hawley’s donor judge and led by Hawley’s wife, will be heard by the Supreme Court later this month.**

* * *
| Friend,

I grew up in poverty with an abusive father who was an alcoholic, but he was still my father.

When he died, my mother took a job taking care of other peoples' kids to provide for her own and to make sure that my siblings and I had a childhood.

Woke liberals will tell you that such an upbringing makes me a Democrat.

**But no matter what the woke media and liberal talking heads tell you, it is my faith in God that has made me the man I am today. It is my faith in God that guided me to achieve the American Dream. **

Who I am & what I believe in threatens the core beliefs of the woke left that race, gender, and economic status determine who we are as Americans.

Thank you & God Bless,
Mark Robinson

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: My story
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
I have found my recovery journey and the fight to end gun violence to be very similar.
#

Friends -
Thirteen years ago, a gunman shot me in the head while I was meeting with constituents in front of a grocery store in Tucson.
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-mar24.5Zicua&refcode=em240311-1-30&t=1&akid=7749%2E3935704%2ECVSs6Z)
Because of the damage the bullet caused to the left hemisphere of my brain, where the language function sits, I have aphasia. This means that even though the words are in my head, I have a hard time getting them out.
**Aphasia may make it harder for me to speak. But I have not lost my voice.**
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-mar24.5Zicua&refcode=em240311-1-30&t=2&akid=7749%2E3935704%2ECVSs6Z)
The road to recovery hasn’t been easy for me, but I’ve never given up. In addition to speech therapy and physical therapy, I dedicate much of my time to riding my bike, playing my French horn, and practicing yoga. These activities have helped me so much in my recovery journey.
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-mar24.5Zicua&refcode=em240311-1-30&t=3&akid=7749%2E3935704%2ECVSs6Z)
I know sometimes the challenge of ending gun violence in our nation can feel overwhelming. When we see the headlines after a mass shooting—or when we remember the countless tragedies that don’t make the news every day—I know how hard it can be.
But friends, we can’t give up. I have found my recovery journey and the fight to end gun violence to be very similar. Even on the hardest days, we can never lose hope.
At the end of this month, we are facing our first FEC quarterly fundraising deadline of the election year. This is a critical test for our movement for gun safety, as both adversaries and allies will be looking to see if we have the resources to take on the gun lobby and elect gun safety champions this November.
So this is where I need to ask for your help:
[**Will you make your first online contribution of $3 to GIFFORDS PAC today? We can’t reach our quarterly fundraising goals without your help.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-mar24.5Zicua&refcode=em240311-1-30&t=4&akid=7749%2E3935704%2ECVSs6Z)

subject: BREAKING: Justice Democrats announces Reject AIPAC coalition

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

We’re announcing something big,
Peter:

Today, a broad alliance of progressive groups is coming together to launch
a first-of-its-kind Reject AIPAC coalition to take on the American Public
Affairs Committee and its affiliated dark money Super PACs as they attack
our progressive Democratic incumbents in Congress.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240311-1.Ktj7Hz&refcode=em20240311-33743&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1001&akid=33743%2E1203867%2EwhcREg ]As progressives, we’re uniting to protect our democracy and stand up
for Palestinian rights by urging the Democratic Party to reject AIPAC once
and for all. Will you help kick off this campaign by pitching in
$3 or more now?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240311-1.Ktj7Hz&refcode=em20240311-33743&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1002&akid=33743%2E1203867%2EwhcREg ]Reject AIPAC from the Democratic Party: Join Us

We have watched as AIPAC has done everything it can to silence growing
dissent in Congress against Netanyahu’s assault on Gaza—which has killed
over 31,000 Palestinians—even as Democratic voters overwhelmingly support
a ceasefire and oppose sending more blank checks to the Israeli military.

Now, AIPAC’s Republican donor-funded Super PAC is threatening to spend
$100 million targeting the handful of Black and brown members of Congress
who have led the calls for a ceasefire and the equal protection of
Palestinian and Israeli lives.

We cannot let a dark money Super PAC, especially one that has endorsed 109
insurrectionist election-deniers and over 200 anti-abortion extremists,
and is funded by Donald Trump’s megadonors, undermine our democracy.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240311-1.Ktj7Hz&refcode=em20240311-33743&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1003&akid=33743%2E1203867%2EwhcREg ]Now is the time for the whole of the Democratic Party to Reject AIPAC
once and for all. If you agree, fuel our work ahead by making a
contribution now →

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240311-1.Ktj7Hz&refcode=em20240311-33743&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1022&akid=33743%2E1203867%2EwhcREg ]Contribute $3

Together, Justice Democrats, US Campaign for Palestinian Rights Action,
Jewish Voice for Peace Action, IfNotNow Movement, the Working Families
Party, Sunrise Movement, Showing Up for Racial Justice, MPower Change
Action Fund, the Democratic Socialists of America, CommonDefense.us, Jews
for Racial and Economic Justice, Center for Popular Democracy Action, Our
Revolution, Dream Defenders, Progressive Democrats of America,
RootsAction, Grassroot Global Justice Action, Justice is Global Action,
Future Coalition, Peace Action, National Iranian American Council Action,
and Gen-Z for Change will organize Democratic voters and elected officials
to reject the destructive influence of the Republican megadonor-backed
lobby group on the Democratic primary process and our government’s policy
towards Palestine and Israel.

We plan to accomplish this through a seven-figure electoral defense
campaign across paid media and field organizing efforts to defend members
of Congress targeted by AIPAC, counterbalance AIPAC’s lobbying efforts on
Capitol Hill, and call on members of Congress to support Palestinian
rights and reject AIPAC’s money and endorsement moving forward.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240311-1.Ktj7Hz&refcode=em20240311-33743&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1023&akid=33743%2E1203867%2EwhcREg ]It’s going to take a lot of work and a lot of financial resources,
which is why we’re coming to you: please chip in anything you can afford
to support our efforts.

We’ll have more updates on our coalition in the coming days and weeks.
Thank you for being in this fight for the soul of the Democratic Party
with us.

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas
Executive Director

Friend,

Made in the USA, it used to be stamped on nearly every product on the shelf. But over 40 years of disastrous economic policy devastated our manufacturing base and hollowed out our working class.

We need an economic revolution that brings good-paying union jobs back and makes America a 21st-century manufacturing superpower. Thanks to the Inflation Reduction Act and the CHIPS Act, we’re on the right path. We’ve added nearly 800,000 new manufacturing jobs in the last three years. And we’re just getting started.

It’s time to get people excited to buy American-made products again. That’s why Representative Debbie Dingell and I have introduced the Made in the USA tax credit. This legislation would provide up to $2,500 in tax credits to individuals and $5,000 to married couples for purchasing goods that meet the Federal Trade Commission's (FTC) Made in the USA standards, which require that a product must be "all or virtually all" made in the U.S.

When we buy American, we make a critical investment in our communities. We support bringing factories and unionized, well-paying manufacturing jobs back to the United States, to communities ravaged by globalization. We combat inflation by making things here at home. We build prosperity and wealth for ourselves and future generations.

Tell Congress: Invest in growing American economic prosperity by passing the Made in the USA tax credit. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/made-in-the-usa-tax-credit?contactdata=kL73v7xnBJPflcZcCTG6Vjmyg5oNQqnOacoJMQaDNnpX3HaHfRUrYlHlbF+uf/PdOZSN6bPWxQjJQFtp1YmLqtzkCwH215/wiSPKi0Ptua2EsRyuPjtQkO+8eI7CQc0HdXdVSH/TA12oNglhcvJp2w==]

Thank you for your activism and all that you do.

In solidarity,
Ro

Wait! One more thing–

Ro doesn't accept a cent from lobbyists or PACs, meaning our work is completely funded by grassroots supporters like you. By donating just $3 today, you’re helping us create a country that works for everyone, not just those at the top. That means a renewed investment in American manufacturing, Medicare for All, student debt relief, and a better future for all.

If you want to support our people-powered campaign as we continue to fight for progress in Washington, please consider making a donation of $3 or more today. Thank you!

RFK Jr.: How I See the State of Our Union
Growing up, I witnessed an America that seemed to have achieved its promise as an exemplary nation – a beacon of freedom, prosperity, and peace. Unfortunately, over the past few decades, we have lost touch with that vision.
Now, we face serious challenges such as chronic illness, violence, loneliness, depression, division, and more. Our great cities have turned into tent encampments, leaving many dispossessed Americans and undocumented immigrants living in despair.
It's evident that our government institutions have faltered and that our leaders have forgotten the difference between true leadership and bullying. The values of integrity and moral authority that were once synonymous with America are now a distant memory.
**But here's the good news:** we can still restore the America we almost had, the America that was the envy of the world. We just need to be honest with ourselves and recognize the reality we face.

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Share the message of Jesus this Easter
body:
The cross of Jesus Christ stands at the center of our faith.
[Unsubscribe](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/os6UxTziuN)
| | | [](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/62922477:s6UxTziuN:m:1:2627245898:471559E0D30F745EDA37CAB65DC965E9:r)
---
Hello Friend, The cross of Jesus Christ stands at the center of our faith. It is the symbol not just of a religion but of the ultimate sacrifice and love displayed by Jesus Christ for humanity.

The cross stands as a reminder of the immense love of God, who sent His only Son to bear the burden of our sins. Through His sacrifice, Jesus provided a path to redemption and eternal life for all who believe in Him.

In moments of hardship and uncertainty, we, as believers, can find strength in the shadow of the cross. It stands as a promise of salvation and the assurance of God's unfailing grace.

The power of the cross lies in its ability to transform lives and reconcile humanity with God. It is the ultimate symbol of victory--victory over sin and death. It offers forgiveness and restoration to all who embrace its message.
---
| | This beautiful full-color 96-page large print "coffee-table style" book is filled with imagery from the Holy Land as well as photographic depictions of key Scriptural events. It can be used as a daily devotional or as a timeless reference resource about the events of Jesus' final week on earth.

A copy of _The Power of the Cross_ is our gift to anyone who supports the ministry of _Pathway to Victory_. By making a secure, generous donation to our work of evangelism and Bible teaching, you are helping many people around the world experience the power of the cross and its message of hope and forgiveness.
---

If you can help, here is a link to make your secure donation and order your copy of _The Power of the Cross_ : [https://secure.ptv.org/the_power_of_the_cross](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/62922477:s6UxTziuN:m:1:2627245898:471559E0D30F745EDA37CAB65DC965E9:r)

Our time for sharing the message of Jesus and the power of the cross grows shorter every day.

Let's make the most of it by partnering together!

Sincerely,

Dr. Robert Jeffress
Senior Pastor, First Baptist Dallas

That's right. Chief Craig is on Team Hudson. He knows MI03 needs a strong voice that supports law enforcement and that's why he's got my back.

|
Friend
Did you hear the news? Chief Craig is on Team Hudson.
---
| Chief Craig's endorsement means a hell of a lot to me. I've defended police officers in the court of law over my career and I fully back our men and women in blue.
Our law enforcement community deserves our support. They selflessly keep our cities safe while Democrats call for the defunding of their departments. If you've had the honor of knowing a police officer personally, you know that they don't pick this job for the pay - they do it because they love their community and its people.
In 2023, Speaker Johnson put a bill on the floor called the POLICE Act. This bill would've required the deportation of any non-U.S. national who has been convicted of (or admits to have committed) any offense involving assault of a law enforcement officer, firefighter, or other first responder.
Guess who voted NO on the POLICE Act?
You guessed it: Hillary Scholten.

name: Al Canata
subject: Bidenomics is why we can’t have nice things
body:
Bidenomics has been terrible for the everyday American.

Friend,

Bidenomics has been terrible for the everyday American. All it has brought us is -
* Rapid inflation due to the printing of money and rampant federal overspending.
* Record amounts of household credit card debt.
* Families falling behind on their car and house payments, along with rising interest rates.

This is a far cry from where we were when the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA) provided a much-needed boost to the economy.

But don't worry, all is not lost.

The National Taxpayers Union-backed Tax Relief for American Families and Workers Act (TRAFWA) will help taxpayers by cementing and expanding upon the legacy of the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act that President Trump signed into law in 2017.

I am Al Canata, Vice President of Strategic Partnerships at the National Taxpayers Union (NTU). I'll tell you more about the Tax Relief for American Families and Workers Act shortly, but first, I need your support in this urgent matter.

**The bipartisan Tax Relief for American Families and Workers Act passed the House and is currently up for consideration in the Senate!**

[Now, I need your help to convince the Senate to pass this bill and win another victory for taxpayers. My goal is to raise $20,000 this month to support our efforts. Please click below to show your support for TRAFWA.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2iijb51ncu7fnajrl65qhi0j25oqjdl73hueg0o_rp22sh2s8i6ep30chgeaob2c3h2bs)

The Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, the first major tax reform in several decades, is often credited with supercharging domestic investment and the overall U.S. economy under Trump.

**Unemployment went down while 401(k) balances and small business confidence went up!**

Fast forward to today. Voters are saying economic worries are their top issue, businesses are cutting jobs in swathes, and President Biden is increasingly vulnerable on his pro-special interest, heavy regulation Bidenomics agenda.

**The Tax Relief for American Families and Workers Act will keep some of the most critical tax provisions working to boost investment and productivity across the economy.**

These broad-based pro-growth and pro-family provisions represent an antidote to the hundreds of billions in special-interest tax breaks that characterized the alternative energy giveaways in Biden's signature Inflation Reduction Act.

Unemployment went down while 401(k) balances and small business confidence went up! Fast forward to today. Voters are saying economic worries are their top issue, businesses are cutting jobs in swathes, and President Biden is increasingly vulnerable on his pro-special interest, heavy regulation Bidenomics agenda. The Tax Relief for American Families and Workers Act will keep some of the most critical tax provisions working to boost investment and productivity across the economy. These broad-based pro-growth and pro-family provisions represent an antidote to the hundreds of billions in special-interest tax breaks that characterized the alternative energy giveaways in Biden's signature Inflation Reduction Act. Your generous support will help NTU 's lobbying efforts in Congress to pass the Tax Relief for American Families and Workers Act. Click below to donate today. Although NTU's Tax Cuts and Jobs Act was one of President Trump's key legislative victories, its significance as a cornerstone of Trump's economic agenda seems to have been forgotten by some Republicans of late. If Congress rejects these tax provisions now, it could make future tax negotiations far more challenging for Republicans. Rejecting this potential signature win so close to the finish line diminishes the Trump tax cuts ' potential reauthorization prospects in 2025 and will harm families, businesses, and the economy. We're working with members of Congress to pass the Tax Relief for American Families and Workers Act and give taxpayers like you the relief they desperately need. Will you help us win another victory for taxpayers in Washington? By Illinois Review

On Sunday, the once-conservative Chicago Tribune took aim at Illinois Trump delegates running in the March 19 primary, pouring over social media posts and public comments of 51 people that have pledged their support to help make President Donald Trump the Republican nominee for President of the United States during the Republican National Convention in July.

In a front page hit piece, the Tribune sounded more like the New York Times or the Washington Post, referring to many of the Trump delegates as election deniers, insurrectionists and anti-vaxxers, but the failing Chicago-based news publication has embraced its hatred for President Trump, publishing editorial after editorial slamming the wildly popular 45th President of the United States, who leads the frail and forgetful President Joe Biden in a head-to-head contest in virtually every national poll.

The failing publication even took aim at Illinois Review and its leadership. Illinois Review, which is one of only a handful of conservative news sources accredited by Google News, is the only Illinois news source that President Trump has
shared (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/01/from-local-to-legendary-trumps-share-catapults-illinois-review-to-national-spotlight.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=26080110db-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_03&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) in recent months.

name: Hillsdale College via Restore Our Nation
subject: How important is religious liberty to you?
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/p4lAV8uVfDOn1k4Ig6nP1w~~/AARclAA~/RgRn0crOP0SxaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjQwMzExVwNzcGNCCmXqfS7vZQ-8m4BSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/p4lAV8uVfDOn1k4Ig6nP1w~~/AARclAA~/RgRn0crOP0SxaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjQwMzExVwNzcGNCCmXqfS7vZQ-8m4BSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. Peter, it's Debbie Mucarsel-Powell.
I’m running to be Florida’s next U.S. Senator — and I hope you’ll give me a moment to share why.
I was born in Ecuador, and when I was 14, my mother brought my sisters and me to America in search of a better life.
We made a new home in a small, one room apartment in America. My mother worked double shifts as a home health care provider and at night, she took classes to learn English. When I was 15, I started picking up shifts at the local doughnut shop to help us make ends meet.
My mother’s hard work, incredible sacrifices, and relentlessly fierce hope made it possible for me to graduate college and become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress. **She taught me that a better education, a better home, and a better future is always possible if we never give up. This is the promise of America.**
_**And that’s why I’m running for Senate. Because Florida deserves better, and we’ve got to fight for it.**_
Right now, our state is being pushed backward by far-right extremists like my opponent, Sen. Rick Scott. He’s targeting the most vulnerable amongst us, dividing our communities, and threatening the American dream. It’s no wonder why a mere 40% of Floridians view him favorably.
With experts saying Rick Scott is one of the most vulnerable senators up for reelection in 2024, I know that we can defeat him and restore the promise of America — but not without all hands on deck.

name: Hillsdale College via Your America News
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c31663%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=uNn9ZpPvyLDATzCSVyw7Vg&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c31664%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2bgvlqdZ0XJ1WyPs7X2ttHg&sysid=1)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c31664%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2bgvlqdZ0XJ1WyPs7X2ttHg&sysid=1)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |
---

We know our country is in deep trouble, and we wonder "what if anything" we can do to save it. As we head off to the polls on Tuesday, March 12th, we have a decision to make. Do we keep electing the same old members of the swamp and ridiculously keep expecting different results, or do we choose a proven conservative fighter who will put America first?
Team Eubanks has been outspent 150 to 1 by the current special interest owned (and 30 year member of the swamp) Roger Wicker. He has the money, because he does the bidding of his special interest donors. That's why he votes with the Democrats more than almost any other Senate Republican, and regularly puts America and American values last.
I do not do the bidding of special interest or leadership, never have, never will. I have a track record of showing that my only loyalties are to "We the people". As your next U.S. Senator, you have my promise that you and the American people are the only ones I will represent. I've also signed a Term Limits pledge because I'm not going to stay forever...I'm going to fight.
Please share this message and get everyone you know to vote in Tuesday's primary. Polls are open from 7am-7pm March 12th. We have the power to send a message and right the ship...we just have to use it. YOU CAN BANK ON EUBANKS!
God bless you and your family, and our great Republic,
Dan Eubanks

body:
NYT’s Trump coverage can’t meet the moment, and it’s putting our democracy in danger.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80756618/460285590/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOGM0ZGU3NjYtYzZkZi1lZTExLTg1ZmItMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=-_F0SlHj-PKm-wLiXcwh_7bnPYxBIJOg9FhQnw8QdZk=&emci=b5aa652b-65dd-ee11-85fb-002248223794&emdi=8c4de766-c6df-ee11-85fb-002248223794&ceid=14016711)
**There’s something wrong at the New York Times, Peter.**
Last September, COURIER’s own Mark Jacob wrote in Stop The Presses: the New York Times has a serious headline problem.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80756619/460285591/-593472309?refcode=20240310-EM-NYTCoverage&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOGM0ZGU3NjYtYzZkZi1lZTExLTg1ZmItMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=-_F0SlHj-PKm-wLiXcwh_7bnPYxBIJOg9FhQnw8QdZk=)
The New York Times relies on an outdated “both sides” model of coverage that focuses on the political horse race and helps their bottom line. But this coverage normalizes Trump and ignores that he’s a threat to our democracy.
**We’re not the only ones talking about it:**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80756620/460285592/-593472309?refcode=20240310-EM-NYTCoverage&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOGM0ZGU3NjYtYzZkZi1lZTExLTg1ZmItMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=-_F0SlHj-PKm-wLiXcwh_7bnPYxBIJOg9FhQnw8QdZk=)
Now, Salon is calling them out, publishing an article saying “there is something wrong at the New York Times,” and that “things aren’t adding up.”
[**Before we go further, if you support our mission to hold mainstream news organizations accountable and publish factual, unbiased coverage in our ten battleground states across the country, will you chip in $10 here?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80756621/460285593/-593472309?refcode=20240310-EM-NYTCoverage&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOGM0ZGU3NjYtYzZkZi1lZTExLTg1ZmItMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=-_F0SlHj-PKm-wLiXcwh_7bnPYxBIJOg9FhQnw8QdZk=)
As 2024 election coverage ramps up, the New York Times has revealed some major issues in its ranks: **most notably, a pro-Trump bias.**
The outlet has relentlessly covered President Biden’s age, but has mostly ignored the question when it comes to Donald Trump (that was true last week, when Trump called Biden Obama for the third time since November).
The day after that, the New York Times blared a headline that suggested, matter of factly, that Biden was behind Trump in their latest poll because voters think Biden is too old.
**We’ve seen this story before. Sensational, both sides coverage is exactly what propelled Donald Trump’s victory over Hillary Clinton in 2016, Peter.**
Here’s the thing: Donald Trump is on the ballot, and the New York Times has to cover him. But their coverage should be _thorough, factual, and unbiased_. That’s where COURIER comes in.
At COURIER, we are committed to providing factual and unbiased coverage, and to calling out organizations like the New York Times who won’t do the same.
We run our ten battleground newsrooms around the country to fight back against lackluster reporting from for-profit news companies, making sure people have access to high-quality news. And we make it _free_.
[**But this work takes resources, Peter, and we rely on the generous support of people like you to help fund our efforts. So if you’re tired of the media constantly putting profits ahead of informative coverage, will you pitch in what you can today and help us keep bringing the facts to communities that need it?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80756622/460285594/-593472309?refcode=20240310-EM-NYTCoverage&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOGM0ZGU3NjYtYzZkZi1lZTExLTg1ZmItMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=-_F0SlHj-PKm-wLiXcwh_7bnPYxBIJOg9FhQnw8QdZk=)

clean_body: NYT’s Trump coverage can’t meet the moment, and it’s putting our democracy in danger. There’s something wrong at the New York Times, Peter. Last September, COURIER’s own Mark Jacob wrote in Stop The Presses: the New York Times has a serious headline problem. = The New York Times relies on an outdated “both sides” model of coverage that focuses on the political horse race and helps their bottom line. But this coverage normalizes Trump and ignores that he’s a threat to our democracy. We’re not the only ones talking about it: = Now, Salon is calling them out, publishing an article saying “there is something wrong at the New York Times,” and that “things aren’t adding up.” = As 2024 election coverage ramps up, the New York Times has revealed some major issues in its ranks: most notably, a pro-Trump bias. The outlet has relentlessly covered President Biden’s age, but has mostly ignored the question when it comes to Donald Trump (that was true last week, when Trump called Biden Obama for the third time since November). The day after that, the New York Times blared a headline that suggested, matter of factly, that Biden was behind Trump in their latest poll because voters think Biden is too old. We’ve seen this story before. Sensational, both sides coverage is exactly what propelled Donald Trump’s victory over Hillary Clinton in 2016, Peter. Here’s the thing: Donald Trump is on the ballot, and the New York Times has to cover him. But their coverage should be thorough, factual, and unbiased. That’s where COURIER comes in. At COURIER, we are committed to providing factual and unbiased coverage, and to calling out organizations like the New York Times who won’t do the same.
