subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=acd775d7644a451b9a8e207de4664d11&_e=m_3JmUzYTJVQL7QRLZiYb-_UqRQuQ5hei77CY4-5LFPVd9V6df_0hTNI6M_o4HAqjDoSlHqjP5tyBPsWHjaVkx4eBT1QfjBk__deyCzDCoYPU1nl6t2ETNpLDTVjCvhcqtyDGKTBhYwc1qLKsCu2CH9aGxiMQUm68JAGaBC34gTiOp7CDi1zhWUwJxEg5hQ0XPK2XE6QOzGN7YCEVsLaZjT78Z4ExYb00pfuh8DdFfaksNIQo5iVDRj8DtzIbjj53lCuWkoA0Hl7uJXs0dn_-u629LRQIgk8AWvkhtrEirSgOLHkZp3qAOiaXQ9BCa5NWo3_TTKSq4pUh8WN_cfvz9u4nHHQDOQtkByGBCbvLQrG8X2hNcmyKdJpMZ7-aT128Pm8CTP1CKGRaAqwm5hp6A%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=acd775d7644a451b9a8e207de4664d11&_e=m_3JmUzYTJVQL7QRLZiYb-_UqRQuQ5hei77CY4-5LFPVd9V6df_0hTNI6M_o4HAqjDoSlHqjP5tyBPsWHjaVkx4eBT1QfjBk__deyCzDCoYPU1nl6t2ETNpLDTVjCvhcqtyDGKTBhYwc1qLKsCu2CH9aGxiMQUm68JAGaBC34gTiOp7CDi1zhWUwJxEg5hQ0XPK2XE6QOzGN7YCEVsLaZjT78Z4ExYb00pfuh8DdFfaksNIQo5iVDRj8DtzIbjj59J2t-Ex7zOiFIp2IoOWuJVxLbzZka94UemtXnS3JAjwkQUpFu2gwe2sotHZtlIMkbhcR6Xolw-uVG-GWd9gbzA2Zm8iIoB89iXhkhAqPHxrq7hCyqFLLsFhGb7g0hOxCX_6yriYW1Opeu5fRsJ_lsg%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=acd775d7644a451b9a8e207de4664d11&_e=m_3JmUzYTJVQL7QRLZiYb-_UqRQuQ5hei77CY4-5LFPVd9V6df_0hTNI6M_o4HAqjDoSlHqjP5tyBPsWHjaVkx4eBT1QfjBk__deyCzDCoYPU1nl6t2ETNpLDTVjCvhcqtyDGKTBhYwc1qLKsCu2CH9aGxiMQUm68JAGaBC34gTiOp7CDi1zhWUwJxEg5hQ0XPK2XE6QOzGN7YCEVsLaZjT78Z4ExYb00pfuh8DdFfaksNIQo5iVDRj8DtzIbjj51X3gwCjEPQtJIKVZdjMhf47Z-6DjivypDtvbl2Kx9fNNL9i9Fu4fOVDiP0YAoeSCzGOtJbnkLEPljtyOA1-Ndu8OUvdtLjma3jYCjlQTrZFHqNa61X3SM1Bn7nUrNSfKZja5BDEb4tVdmk6qMU85CQ%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| | Dear Friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That's why we produced "[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=d47395c5ea5f4c27b74829be5662fa3f&_e=0NEkSqvp5r9lqWjiOZW7wQyQaep_0IBFmvPL4FfEncva8TEznVTPobnrRrZuEbcKqZdi-ulodWug7i0kv_2uM77c4algfFJTJbwt9k4NdJydeq0izCgAQD1CItktP-wcaixOw7bTOInZ_4q6KyIHmAzsEkAdJsz5VqS6GHRz6hr5tHplRc8gM2A91nSF-DsikFtEC0kGWB4QEk3BEHlBMeydL85WvTLhz0eCuSByyIxnMjr3Rcvncx9VmC3ZhIsE6JD4DmpL7ICaBtMIWOb3hXVeTZLhP2MDGwNy7aGe_FyNTinbRU-4619unOnLBB2SfUzrZjVdbHcbFxnFS9wyweclCw5LVnDTHzlgNgmhwtHVpw_A_WrCWV6GMQJzTfXao4LhbZwR-vh38VFOBf5Za_ng4JsRW9ZfdyCrpmJEmHrVh0VNqZpPtlqSUNNCkZis)" which you can now own on DVD.

| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful DVD box set](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=d47395c5ea5f4c27b74829be5662fa3f&_e=0NEkSqvp5r9lqWjiOZW7wQyQaep_0IBFmvPL4FfEncva8TEznVTPobnrRrZuEbcKqZdi-ulodWug7i0kv_2uM77c4algfFJTJbwt9k4NdJydeq0izCgAQD1CItktP-wcaixOw7bTOInZ_4q6KyIHmAzsEkAdJsz5VqS6GHRz6hr5tHplRc8gM2A91nSF-DsikFtEC0kGWB4QEk3BEHlBMeydL85WvTLhz0eCuSByyIxnMjr3Rcvncx9VmC3ZhIsE6JD4DmpL7ICaBtMIWOb3hXVeTZLhP2MDGwNy7aGe_FwbM1tay1V3Lhk4yQJJlE6PNZz_G7LMIyG6RfgQLqFtYtX3vBQwKJXC_AomyreByMmk_u82RXUu0KW5wrbhn1vnulFq0dID-Q7tzCgr9CYp9kPkCFJvsNbymcpKlAQyf-jSDkYjFi8ssvw6a9NAzFU7).

subject: Justice, weaponized
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=c8e4c5f13c8b4ff68f08aa7389169d4a&_e=wtj4RBjHT3DZhdWtf0OOZJ6fhWMky3F9pCLm3Bc5_BVOMhOIdwWMqafrGi52A9kikW5WGnpboJSeDTPLIt7_xPG99daxoi8YzrNFtGJGDQB5DjHXHiSDgsY8yJz5ji6u8iNHjjWfizxsxnE4BC7nry-XAvfVQGuWh987uYLAVH2Nx50wWupyw1ZzaeYpwmdz6uijJ3qERkpl9vG99zkdI8Fei0sYX7bmnkZUq91lBw6ZhNrtaqSNi0j067LOCatPrPa6YUd90hN9dQnS_n9bhucaZAx3xCdrwt2NWtyvsRGqNNLyVH-eBEpTaUQY5Rgs69rQ1i0XG7gK3_Oa8SUU7Aiz5_diOr6yDMa63vUmImY4Puqu1_FL6j-AX1CLdWJ7kPkpUG1VHvcW8ZSkoMrp3A%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=c8e4c5f13c8b4ff68f08aa7389169d4a&_e=wtj4RBjHT3DZhdWtf0OOZJ6fhWMky3F9pCLm3Bc5_BVOMhOIdwWMqafrGi52A9kikW5WGnpboJSeDTPLIt7_xPG99daxoi8YzrNFtGJGDQB5DjHXHiSDgsY8yJz5ji6u8iNHjjWfizxsxnE4BC7nry-XAvfVQGuWh987uYLAVH2Nx50wWupyw1ZzaeYpwmdz6uijJ3qERkpl9vG99zkdI8Fei0sYX7bmnkZUq91lBw6ZhNrtaqSNi0j067LOCatP73RhR7k3JM8GsmT_4gLGGuvt2XeIPE2zaBmi1N61pgcI2gZPykqABK_tlnxlfN-y3WLMpa0i0i1ajjyBg-Rkjoyf54a4MR-AmYvmF1lsbgmc_dUqPMsX15kEVdO0egre9kgG33_mJJAKdU45aS9diw%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=c8e4c5f13c8b4ff68f08aa7389169d4a&_e=wtj4RBjHT3DZhdWtf0OOZJ6fhWMky3F9pCLm3Bc5_BVOMhOIdwWMqafrGi52A9kikW5WGnpboJSeDTPLIt7_xPG99daxoi8YzrNFtGJGDQB5DjHXHiSDgsY8yJz5ji6u8iNHjjWfizxsxnE4BC7nry-XAvfVQGuWh987uYLAVH2Nx50wWupyw1ZzaeYpwmdz6uijJ3qERkpl9vG99zkdI8Fei0sYX7bmnkZUq91lBw6ZhNrtaqSNi0j067LOCatPFsWtGkvAMMT0qh1puSPeyiUeJL99BAzdcy8Qvhs7qh0lKIKZbnHTFiJebyt7AZDQAWau2Ee6luGESULmlE4-bh7gbsmZEHq2CRRhMknBvNuBzkx_e080z9av5KiGFpQdzo6n16pSGqJJZ45gQPkKkA%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. | | | Friend,

I can't explain how grateful I am that you chose to read this email. Only about 30-40% of folks open these messages, and look I get it - there are a lot of political emails being sent these days.

Unfortunately, I rely on emails, texts, mail, and phone calls to stay in touch with conservatives like you.

name: Barbara Lee via Our Revolution
subject: What’s next? The future of the progressive movement
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Our Revolution click here to unsubscribe
body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

Peter Willis — Hi, I’m
Barbara Lee with a personal message on where we go from here.

First, I want to thank you for powering my Senate campaign through Our
Revolution’s work.

Because of dedicated supporters like you, we made over 2 MILLION voter
contacts in California — lifting up our issue priorities for Peace,
healthcare for all, environmental justice, racial equality, and so much
more.

While we didn’t prevail, our grassroots movement for bold progressive
change is just getting started. But, despite being heavily outspent by my
opponents, our values never wavered. Now more than ever, I’m fired up to
keep fighting alongside you for the values we believe in – justice,
equality, and opportunity for all.

Through this campaign, we’ve built a powerful coalition of Black, Latino,
and AAPI leaders; young people; the LGBTQ+ community; reproductive freedom
advocates; and progressives like us who will keep working together to
advance our movement for justice.

But here’s our challenge: We learned that big money and corporate power
will do whatever it takes to undercut progressive candidates like myself
and our people-centered policy goals.

That’s why I’m proud to announce that I’ll keep working with Our
Revolution and our coalition this 2024 election cycle and beyond to make
sure progressive candidates have the financial resources and strategic
support to overcome structural barriers — and WIN.

I’ll have more details soon, but I wanted to let you know first that our
fight for the future will continue.

Our nation and our world are facing existential threats - Trump, war,
climate chaos, and more - but together we have laid a path forward that we
can’t afford to abandon.

In gratitude & solidarity,

Barbara Lee
U.S. Congresswoman (CA-12)
Friend of Our Revolution

name: Bob Lorinser
subject: Naysayers
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE FRIENDS OF DR
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/TOP.png]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
I'll be quick this morning. If you agree, grassroots contributions are helping my candidacy show strength going into the primary. Our budgets are tight, I'm reliant on the generosity of people like you, and I'm grateful to have you in my corner.
JOIN OUR FIGHT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Friends,
In the '60s they said the Civil Rights bill was "impossible".
Today, make no mistake — any time candidates or lawmakers say the US "can't do" universal healthcare, it means they lack the political will to fight for it.
If naysayers don't believe it's possible, if they don't realize the savings ($500 billion a year), if they lack the courage to stand for what the majority of Americans want , they don't deserve to be contenders for the People's House.
The truth is, we can't afford not to do it. Regarding healthcare reform, it's just not enough to say we need "access to care."
We need healthcare for all; we need it now, and our leaders' wisdom, courage, and competence make it possible.
Our nation's major milestones were achieved by leaders with visions - fueled by and for the people. They created paths forward and made the impossible possible.
To my opponents - if you don't share that vision, get out of the way.
To all others - thank you for standing with me in this fight. I'm in it for all of us.
-Dr. Bob
Bob Lorinser
Candidate for US Congress
Northern Michigan / Upper Peninsula
Democrat, MI01

name: Colin Allred
subject: It's official: I'm the Democratic nominee for Senate in Texas
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Serve America PAC
body:
http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-allred [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-allred]
Friend, I’m Colin Allred, and I'm the official Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate against Ted Cruz.
Now, the real fight begins. I'm ready to outwork, outraise, and out-organize Ted Cruz to win this thing, and with multiple polls already showing me TIED with Ted, I'm confident we can do it. But I also know Cruz is backed by wealthy mega donors who will spend whatever it takes to keep him in office.
That’s why I need you with me: Please, will you chip in $15 – or whatever you can spare – to help reach my $1 million General Election Kickoff goal?
Every dollar you can spare will power our people-powered movement through Election Day so we can defeat Ted Cruz and deliver better, stronger leadership for the people of Texas. Will you help kick our campaign off in a huge way by donating $15 or more to me and Serve America right now? → [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-allred]
I’m a fourth generation Texan, born and raised in Dallas by a single mom. My mom was a public school teacher and sometimes worked two jobs to make ends meet. Thanks to my family and a strong support system of teachers, coaches, and the good folks at the YMCA, I earned a full-ride football scholarship to Baylor University and then went on to play in the NFL.
But playing football was never my only dream – from a young age I knew I wanted to help people. So I became a civil rights attorney to defend what I believe is our most fundamental right: the right to vote. I proudly served in President Obama’s administration before I came home to Dallas, where my wife, Aly, and I are now raising our family.
I ran for Congress in 2018 because I wanted more kids in North Texas to have the opportunity to achieve their version of the American dream. I also saw that our democracy was in peril and wanted to be part of protecting it. No one gave me a chance in that race, but I beat the odds to defeat an 11-term Republican incumbent. Since then, I'm proud to have been named the most bipartisan member of the Texas delegation.
Now, I’m ready for my next challenge: firing Ted Cruz and being the voice all Texans need in the Senate. We're already better off than we were in 2018, with experts calling Cruz the most vulnerable GOP Senator in the country, and two polls in a row showing us tied. I'm not saying it will be easy, but with you on my grassroots team, I know we can get it done.
That’s why I’m asking you to chip in right now to become a General Election Founding Donor and help reach our ambitious $1 million goal. We need an unprecedented grassroots movement to unseat Ted Cruz, and I’m counting on you to be a part of it. Please, rush $15, or whatever you can spare, to help me and Serve America win in Texas, defeat Ted Cruz, and give Texans the leadership we deserve. → [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-allred]
Thank you so much for being a part of my team. Your support has gotten me this far, and it's why I know we can win.
Let's do this,

clean_body: [] Friend, I’m Colin Allred, and I'm the official Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate against Ted Cruz. Now, the real fight begins. I'm ready to outwork, outraise, and out-organize Ted Cruz to win this thing, and with multiple polls already showing me TIED with Ted, I'm confident we can do it. But I also know Cruz is backed by wealthy mega donors who will spend whatever it takes to keep him in office. That’s why I need you with me: Please, will you chip in $15 – or whatever you can spare – to help reach my $1 million General Election Kickoff goal? Every dollar you can spare will power our people-powered movement through Election Day so we can defeat Ted Cruz and deliver better, stronger leadership for the people of Texas. Will you help kick our campaign off in a huge way by donating $15 or more to me and Serve America right now? → [] I’m a fourth generation Texan, born and raised in Dallas by a single mom. My mom was a public school teacher and sometimes worked two jobs to make ends meet. Thanks to my family and a strong support system of teachers, coaches, and the good folks at the YMCA, I earned a full-ride football scholarship to Baylor University and then went on to play in the NFL. But playing football was never my only dream – from a young age I knew I wanted to help people. So I became a civil rights attorney to defend what I believe is our most fundamental right: the right to vote. I proudly served in President Obama’s administration before I came home to Dallas, where my wife, Aly, and I are now raising our family. I ran for Congress in 2018 because I wanted more kids in North Texas to have the opportunity to achieve their version of the American dream. I also saw that our democracy was in peril and wanted to be part of protecting it. No one gave me a chance in that race, but I beat the odds to defeat an 11-term Republican incumbent. Since then, I'm proud to have been named the most bipartisan member of the Texas delegation. Now, I’m ready for my next challenge: firing Ted Cruz and being the voice all Texans need in the Senate. We're already better off than we were in 2018, with experts calling Cruz the most vulnerable GOP Senator in the country, and two polls in a row showing us tied. I'm not saying it will be easy, but with you on my grassroots team, I know we can get it done. That’s why I’m asking you to chip in right now to become a General Election Founding Donor and help reach our ambitious $1 million goal. We need an unprecedented grassroots movement to unseat Ted Cruz, and I’m counting on you to be a part of it. Please, rush $15, or whatever you can spare, to help me and Serve America win in Texas, defeat Ted Cruz, and give Texans the leadership we deserve. → [] Thank you so much for being a part of my team. Your support has gotten me this far, and it's why I know we can win. body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Full Mag News is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=43ebe483acd248189f6e9840ca0010e9&_e=qo1Vm_OPw3mo-bJ6E0_ALuPWKCel3vucuNXKULehbWPUAjGArTzhY864lTxOfkSi1-DnhYtG7siknNIX6mmwlFCzHh0N1cWj9EWfZ2Gt0sLnwZd2l3jcMJeoSk_uMqhTsCGBSSCoVBzMjRf8DuzW0pQYPhqwNciFFH6bn9Ev8kiel-l4vv3C_RZK7AgbYlotzfAvk9mYh02jcubLJFJHXKrTvy3KIOwPbGhALTuwulfEjel--N-cnaK7I9K5OBNp4yPr6Khv-2Z5SdpFSl4GHTe1ZsygsJPUy70hwhCve2N9HeDSM2M2IJnHAiZqLRvGs3Uh68EvjNRb-LECXUA-PyANwOgz2-Tw3IcLh8lLL9sJJSqH0REDt7LZFtILsHM5JQOx1MbLjJg_cV0MhqTBTQ%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=43ebe483acd248189f6e9840ca0010e9&_e=qo1Vm_OPw3mo-bJ6E0_ALuPWKCel3vucuNXKULehbWPUAjGArTzhY864lTxOfkSi1-DnhYtG7siknNIX6mmwlFCzHh0N1cWj9EWfZ2Gt0sLnwZd2l3jcMJeoSk_uMqhTsCGBSSCoVBzMjRf8DuzW0pQYPhqwNciFFH6bn9Ev8kiel-l4vv3C_RZK7AgbYlotzfAvk9mYh02jcubLJFJHXKrTvy3KIOwPbGhALTuwulfEjel--N-cnaK7I9K5OBNphTwoQj7cL2o_zsJvvl_kcGSoCU6fdVOhkyHxcAnnBseerVshRVHzVoqlL8usE7lj3Nzh1MCEDRGZtzPs01mmY-MSIQnG_45tFkfscuwXqVqtKlL_QqYzTdPdKcsDaT1_PEvQQwYQaeXZlZX80SYBeg%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=43ebe483acd248189f6e9840ca0010e9&_e=qo1Vm_OPw3mo-bJ6E0_ALuPWKCel3vucuNXKULehbWPUAjGArTzhY864lTxOfkSi1-DnhYtG7siknNIX6mmwlFCzHh0N1cWj9EWfZ2Gt0sLnwZd2l3jcMJeoSk_uMqhTsCGBSSCoVBzMjRf8DuzW0pQYPhqwNciFFH6bn9Ev8kiel-l4vv3C_RZK7AgbYlotzfAvk9mYh02jcubLJFJHXKrTvy3KIOwPbGhALTuwulfEjel--N-cnaK7I9K5OBNpH25llNbGIUB6wHzIXnYUt6Qsnjr-UOHgBzXziAtXicgBlnVZy6SQCnQMBLs3iktLXIi6pfaKin3mbaimiR1DTZjgEIpWNMDbazD4kRP6QwCdjnhrporv5_FQIr19XYzsXr5vx1WkWDdi-zZbHgnzLw%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. | | | | | _**Women’s History Month Trailblazers:** During March 2024, Blue Amp Action is highlighting several female candidates around the country who we believe deserve a spotlight on their campaigns. Today, we’re shining a light on Dr. Pamela Pugh who is running for Congress in Michigan’s 8th District._ Peter, This is Dr. Pamela Pugh. I’m reaching out to you today as a fellow Democrat activist. **Here’s my big news: I've stepped up to run for Congress in Michigan’s 8th District in 2024 – one of the 21 toss-up districts around the country that will decide if Democrats take back the House in 2024.** As a candidate, I have decades of public service and advocacy experience that I can use to win over the hearts and minds of voters: I was the Chief Public Health Official tasked with cleaning up the Flint Water Crisis, and have led the fight to end childhood lead poisoning in Michigan at the state capitol. Years of Republican-controlled government and “Emergency Managers” in Michigan have particularly harmed our state’s education system and environment, and I’ve had to lead the fight to clean up the mess. Now, I’m ready to help fix the MAGA mess in the House of Representatives. Now that I’ve explained a bit about my campaign and why I’m running. This will be a "toss-up" level competitive race in November according to the Cook Political Report. name: Hillsdale College via Restore Our Nation
subject: How important is religious liberty to you?
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/DiVC2D29uWSh8EcNz7vBFw~~/AARclAA~/RgRn0djeP0SxaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjQwMzExVwNzcGNCCmXvzUTvZT1I_j9SFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/DiVC2D29uWSh8EcNz7vBFw~~/AARclAA~/RgRn0djeP0SxaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjQwMzExVwNzcGNCCmXvzUTvZT1I_j9SFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/DiVC2D29uWSh8EcNz7vBFw~~/AARclAA~/RgRn0djeP0SxaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjQwMzExVwNzcGNCCmXvzUTvZT1I_j9SFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| Restore Our Nation

Friend,

I grew up in Brooklyn as the son of an exterminator and a stay-at-home mom, and a descendant of victims of the Holocaust. My friend Jacky Rosen grew up in a working-class family as the granddaughter of Jewish immigrants and the daughter of a World War II veteran.
Today, I have the great privilege and responsibility of serving as the first Jewish Senate majority leader in our nation’s history, and Jacky is the only Jewish woman currently serving in the U.S. Senate.
**Don’t ever tell me that things can’t change.**

Our humble origins and shared Jewish faith are at the core of what motivates our work together in the Senate. Every day, we’re fighting to make progress on the real issues Americans face: lowering everyday costs for families, combating hate and discrimination, and restoring reproductive freedom.
But the GOP has a different vision for America, which is why they’re trying to defeat Jacky and enact their toxic agenda.

Right now, Republicans are targeting Jacky’s seat in battleground Nevada as the key to Senate control. Mitch McConnell personally selected an extreme GOP opponent to run against her, and he just set a new fundraising record. Donald Trump has been campaigning aggressively in Nevada to rally support from his MAGA base.
**We can’t let the only Jewish woman serving in the Senate stand against the full force of the GOP alone. But with polling showing Jacky tied neck and neck with her opponent right now, she needs all the help she can get to fight back. That’s why I’m personally reaching out to ask for your support:**
**[Will you please join me in supporting Jacky's reelection campaign by giving $5 or more now? Every dollar will make a critical difference in keeping Nevada blue, defending our Senate majority, and ensuring that Jacky and I can both continue making progress for the American people.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80764737/460305568/1553268835?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk3556-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMWM3M2I3ZS1kMWRmLWVlMTEtODVmYi0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kMaqvfdA5deABSNW3t1i66UIPeoSxtOzAn52oUDowiI=)**
Thank you for your support, Friend.

Chuck Schumer

Friend, To November we go! Thanks to your continued investments over the last several months, I will be the Republican nominee for California’s 2nd Congressional District. A big shout-out to everyone who helped us win this battle — my team, my volunteers, my endorsers, and my donors. THANK YOU! **[I am honored to have earned your unwavering support in the primaries, and I will need more of it over the next eight months. Please chip in whatever you can to my GENERAL ELECTION campaign »](https://nb.christocongress.com/r?u=vLzcBttMlHPwnhM1pQ23paEVimo0rylpeDdAmHdq2BR2IjcurluruksHlxtWPkG3YoXdDW5FHU5FFKA5s0fM4fZ0vMR7CrbI9cK6Vs0K_a8&e=826a47930363a3c7550ba96ed32bd779&utm_source=christocongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=we_won_the_battle&n=2)** I’m a military Veteran, and I speak plainly: **I face a grueling, uphill battle against a well-funded incumbent Democrat, a party man.** The Democratic Party has had a stranglehold on the North Coast for decades. They won’t let it go without a fight. I promise to fight harder than my opponent. I will fight for clean, plentiful water, safe streets and secure borders, high-performing schools, a tax exemption for all Veterans and a tax suspension for middle-class families. The North Coast deserves — it needs — fresh leadership whose first concern is the PEOPLE, not the party. With your continued support, we can shock the establishment and restore the North Coast. Semper Fidelis,
**Chris Coulombe**
Republican Nominee for California’s 2nd Congressional District **[P.S. I am a Sonoma native and lifelong resident. I served my country in uniform for 16 years. Now, I aim to represent my community in Washington. My opponent will mobilize his party’s machine against me. Help me defeat them. [1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

If we’re going to protect our democracy and Palestinian human rights, we
need to reject AIPAC’s influence in the Democratic Party.

The pro-war, anti-Palestinian lobby group and their Super PAC are
threatening to spend $100 million against Democrats this election cycle in
an attempt to unseat progressive, pro-peace members of Congress like the
Squad — and they’re doing it through millions in contributions from
Republican billionaires, corporate interests, and Donald Trump’s donors.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140402?t=1001&akid=33741%2E1203867%2Ebr3Vf8 ]Justice Democrats is teaming up with a broad coalition of progressive
organizations to urgently fight back: will you join the fight to get
Democratic elected officials to reject AIPAC now?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140402?t=1002&akid=33741%2E1203867%2Ebr3Vf8 ]Reject AIPAC and Donald Trump's megadonors that fund them. JOIN US

AIPAC frames itself as a bipartisan group, but their Super PAC, the United
Democracy Project, only spends against Democrats in Democratic primaries —
and overwhelmingly against Black and brown progressives who support a
permanent ceasefire in Gaza to stop the Israeli military’s genocide and
ethnic cleansing of Palestinians.

The GOP megadonor-funded group also endorsed 109 Republican candidates who
pushed the Big Lie and refused to certify the 2020 presidential election
results, inspiring the January 6 insurrection on the U.S. Capitol.

In 2024, AIPAC is trying to tighten its grip on Congress and U.S. foreign
policy by influencing the outcomes of Democratic primaries and attacking
progressive incumbents. But our movement is coming together to stop them.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140402?t=1003&akid=33741%2E1203867%2Ebr3Vf8 ]Now is the time for the whole of the Democratic Party to Reject AIPAC

**So, after I turned 15, I got a job working the early morning shift at a local donut shop.** It was just a minimum wage job, but the small checks I brought home gave my family room to breathe. Finally, after a lot of hard work, the possibilities that we could only dream of before became reality.
We were able to move out of that one room apartment, and I got a scholarship to an incredible college. Eventually, I found a career path where I could give back to the communities and country that gave me so much. That call to service took me to places I had never even dreamed of before. **I became the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and now, I'm running for the United States Senate.**
**Making donuts in the morning before homeroom brought me all the way to Congress. ****I've seen time and time again how small acts have the power to create big, transformative change._And that's exactly how we're going to win this campaign in November._**

I'm about to ask you to help me hit my $500,000 mid-month fundraising goal. But first, I want to tell you a story about donuts — and how they're going to help us save our Senate majority. = = When I was 14, my family came to America to seek a better life. We arrived here with big dreams for the future. But those early days were hard. I remember my mom working back-to-back double shifts and still struggling to afford rent for our small, one room apartment. So, after I turned 15, I got a job working the early morning shift at a local donut shop. It was just a minimum wage job, but the small checks I brought home gave my family room to breathe. Finally, after a lot of hard work, the possibilities that we could only dream of before became reality. We were able to move out of that one room apartment, and I got a scholarship to an incredible college. Eventually, I found a career path where I could give back to the communities and country that gave me so much. That call to service took me to places I had never even dreamed of before. I became the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and now, I'm running for the United States Senate. Making donuts in the morning before homeroom brought me all the way to Congress. If Democrat Marilyn Lands wins in Alabama, it would send shockwaves through the Republican Party. But, this special election is about so much more than winning, it’s about: ✅ Expanding Democratic power in a ruby-red state, 💪 Electing a pro-abortion champion in a state where Republicans are hellbent on banning reproductive freedoms, 🛑 And sending a resounding message to MAGA extremists that their far-right, deeply unpopular agenda won’t win with voters. In states like Alabama and nationwide, we’re running out of time to make the necessary investments that will be vital to mobilizing voters and WINNING. Majorities aren’t built in a day, they’re built one seat at a time in races just like this one. If Democrats lose in Alabama, it’d be a devastating blow to the pro-choice movement in our fight to protect reproductive rights. name: Pennsylvania Forward Party
subject: 3/26 Candidate Launch Day
body:
2 candidates, 3 events in 3 cities

| [](https://home.forwardparty.com/20240326_pa_candidate_launch?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240326_launch_announcement&n=1) Peter -- We at the Pennsylvania Forward Party are proud to introduce **two very exciting people**. They will represent the Pennsylvania Forward this year as **candidates for statewide office**. You'll hear a lot more about these candidates from us, Forward National, and hopefully, from your local sources of Pennsylvania news over the next few months. Help us get these candidates off to the best possible start by **attending one or more of the launch events on Tuesday, March 26 th, to meet them in person.** These announcements are also a great moment for the National Forward Party. Pennsylvania is one of the key states with opportunities to put Forwardists in office. We'll be joined by **big-name guests from National Forward Leadership and Partnered office holders**. | [](https://home.forwardparty.com/20240326_pa_candidate_launch?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240326_launch_announcement&n=2 "Launch Information") [Launch Information](https://home.forwardparty.com/20240326_pa_candidate_launch?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240326_launch_announcement&n=2)
---
The March 26th **Launch Forward Day** will include **3 separate events**. The two morning events will be in **Pittsburgh at 9:30 am** and in **Philadelphia at 10 am**. Attendees from these two announcements will then journey to **Harrisburg at 2:30 pm** for a joint candidate announcement. We encourage everyone to join us at their local Candidate Announcement in the morning and join us in Harrisburg in the afternoon (if able)!
Please RSVP for an event so we can keep you up to date on details as we can release them by clicking on the links below.
* ## [Pittsburgh, 9:30 am](https://home.forwardparty.com/20240326_launch_pittsburgh?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240326_launch_announcement&n=3)
* ## [Philadelphia, 10 am](https://home.forwardparty.com/20240326_launch_philadelphia?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240326_launch_announcement&n=4)
* ## [Harrisburg, 2:30 pm](https://home.forwardparty.com/20240326_launch_harrisburg?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240326_launch_announcement&n=5)

**You can learn much more about the event and why we're so excited by attending our monthly call on 3/18 at 8 pm.**
[](https://home.forwardparty.com/pa_fwd_march_statewide_meeting_20240318?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240326_launch_announcement&n=6)

Friend,

Bidenomics has been terrible for the everyday American. All it has brought us is -
* Rapid inflation due to the printing of money and rampant federal overspending.
* Record amounts of household credit card debt.
* Families falling behind on their car and house payments, along with rising interest rates.

This is a far cry from where we were when the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA) provided a much-needed boost to the economy.

But don't worry, all is not lost.

The National Taxpayers Union-backed Tax Relief for American Families and Workers Act (TRAFWA) will help taxpayers by cementing and expanding upon the legacy of the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act that President Trump signed into law in 2017.

I am Al Canata, Vice President of Strategic Partnerships at the National Taxpayers Union (NTU). I'll tell you more about the Tax Relief for American Families and Workers Act shortly, but first, I need your support in this urgent matter.

**The bipartisan Tax Relief for American Families and Workers Act passed the House and is currently up for consideration in the Senate!**

[Now, I need your help to convince the Senate to pass this bill and win another victory for taxpayers. My goal is to raise $20,000 this month to support our efforts. subject: I was in prison, now I’m running for Congress

| [ ](https://oeypev.clicks.mlsend.com/tf/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjg2MTExMixcImxcIjoxMTU1MzY5NTUxOTk5ODExNjEsXCJyXCI6MTE1NTM3MDQwOTI3MzYwNDg1fSIsInMiOiI3NTUyMzBhMWZhMjY3ZmI0In0)
---
|
---
Friend,

Growing up I was the oldest of three in a Black single-parent household. Our family didn’t have much and my mom sacrificed every day to instill in us the importance of hard work and service to others.

I spent my early years studying and working on political campaigns like the 1991 Clinton-Gore campaign, Hillary Clinton’s initial Senate run, and Congressman Gregory Meeks’ first campaign for city council (which he lost) and his subsequent campaign for state assembly and eventual successful run for Congress.

I went on to attend the prestigious New York University (NYU) Schack Institute of Real Estate where I got my Bachelor’s degree and entered into a career in the real estate finance industry.

Things were on the up and up. I had learned so much through working campaigns and at NYU. **However, some of my most valuable lessons and formative experiences came from my time in prison.

** It was the early 2000s, I was Vice President of US Mortgage, a national mortgage lender.

Through my role as Vice President at US Mortgage I was introduced to a foreign businessman buying a condo from a large real estate broker. The broker asked me if I could help him purchase the property and I said yes.

As I would later find out, the man was part of a massive international money laundering operation that was using fake checks to make large financial transactions. Utilizing an inside man at the payroll giant, Paychex, they were printing out fraudulent checks on standard Paychex stock and passing them off as the real thing.

Not knowing the checks were fake I accepted them putting them into a client services escrow account and they cleared...

_I was young, naive, and overly eager to bring in a big deal for my firm._ I chose to trust this foreign businessman without doing the proper research into his background. **I made a mistake and I would ultimately pay the price for it.

** 30 days later I got a knock on the door from the Secret Service who were investigating the checks and for the next four years I cooperated with State and Federal investigators as they investigated the businessman and his inside man at Paychex.

Because of my cooperation I accepted a deal in which I pled guilty to conspiracy, a catch all charge used by the government to prosecute anyone peripherally involved with something criminal, and in exchange received five months of jail and two years of probation.

While at the time it seemed like the end of the world, prison was ultimately the best thing that could have happened to me.
|
---
| [ ](https://oeypev.clicks.mlsend.com/tf/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjg2MTExMixcImxcIjoxMTU1MzY5NTUyMDQxNzU0NjYsXCJyXCI6MTE1NTM3MDQwOTI3MzYwNDg1fSIsInMiOiI3MGM1NmRjNGVjZTFmNTgyIn0)
---
| _Fort Dix - the low security correctional facility where I served my time at. I can’t technically claim that I was behind bars as I served at the facilities work camp._
---
|
---
From drug dealers to corporate CEOs I learned so much from the people from every walk of life who I found myself surrounded by.

I also saw firsthand how the Black and brown people there had far longer sentences than their white peers. Affluence affects legal representation - some of the guys serving 10 to 15 years there would still probably be doing time but would have likely been doing way less time if they’d had adequate legal representation.

From listening to my peers I also learned how in many cases their criminal acts didn’t happen in a vacuum but were instead influenced by many factors like education, poverty, family relationships and more.

Prison and the experience of making a mistake and going through the criminal justice system provided me with a foundational learning experience that has made me a better listener, made me more empathetic, and has made me that much hungrier to fight for the voiceless. Now that I am a father it is my life’s mission to set a good example for my son and to give back to my community.

When I got out in 2007 I found a vastly different financial landscape than what I had left. The 2008 crash and its leadup was devastating for the real estate and financial world - giant firms in my industry closed their doors, colleagues of mine committed suicide, and it seemed like the economy was on the brink. Despite this I managed to claw my way out and get back onto the track I was on pre-prison.

Since then I helped to elect President Obama in 2008 getting out the vote for him across NYC, I worked to help elect Governor Andrew Cuomo, I’ve been appointed to boards by NYC Mayor Michael Bloomberg, became a partner at a real estate investment firm, and most importantly I am a father.
|
---
| [ ](https://oeypev.clicks.mlsend.com/tf/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjg2MTExMixcImxcIjoxMTU1MzY5NTUyMDgzNjk3NzUsXCJyXCI6MTE1NTM3MDQwOTI3MzYwNDg1fSIsInMiOiI2ZmNmMTY3NzdhYjBiNmY0In0)
---
| __My son and I._ _
---
|
---
Now I am proudly launching my campaign for Congress in New York’s 4th Congressional district — **one of the most flippable districts in the nation.

** My GOP opponent, Congressman Anthony D’Esposito (R-NY), campaigns about being tough on crime but when he was an officer with the NYPD he received numerous complaints, among them for excessive force, and was let go for abusing his power.

Democrats held NY-04 for over 25 years, but that changed last year when we lost big in the district and throughout Long Island. I can flip NY-04 blue because I have the background and life experiences to connect with the moderate and independent voters who we lost last time.

clean_body: | | | | | | | Friend, Growing up I was the oldest of three in a Black single-parent household. Our family didn’t have much and my mom sacrificed every day to instill in us the importance of hard work and service to others. I spent my early years studying and working on political campaigns like the 1991 Clinton-Gore campaign, Hillary Clinton’s initial Senate run, and Congressman Gregory Meeks’ first campaign for city council (which he lost) and his subsequent campaign for state assembly and eventual successful run for Congress. I went on to attend the prestigious New York University (NYU) Schack Institute of Real Estate where I got my Bachelor’s degree and entered into a career in the real estate finance industry. Things were on the up and up. I had learned so much through working campaigns and at NYU. However, some of my most valuable lessons and formative experiences came from my time in prison. It was the early 2000s, I was Vice President of US Mortgage, a national mortgage lender. Through my role as Vice President at US Mortgage I was introduced to a foreign businessman buying a condo from a large real estate broker. The broker asked me if I could help him purchase the property and I said yes. As I would later find out, the man was part of a massive international money laundering operation that was using fake checks to make large financial transactions. Utilizing an inside man at the payroll giant, Paychex, they were printing out fraudulent checks on standard Paychex stock and passing them off as the real thing. Not knowing the checks were fake I accepted them putting them into a client services escrow account and they cleared... I was young, naive, and overly eager to bring in a big deal for my firm. I chose to trust this foreign businessman without doing the proper research into his background. I made a mistake and I would ultimately pay the price for it. 30 days later I got a knock on the door from the Secret Service who were investigating the checks and for the next four years I cooperated with State and Federal investigators as they investigated the businessman and his inside man at Paychex. Because of my cooperation I accepted a deal in which I pled guilty to conspiracy, a catch all charge used by the government to prosecute anyone peripherally involved with something criminal, and in exchange received five months of jail and two years of probation. While at the time it seemed like the end of the world, prison was ultimately the best thing that could have happened to me. | | | Fort Dix - the low security correctional facility where I served my time at. I can’t technically claim that I was behind bars as I served at the facilities work camp. | From drug dealers to corporate CEOs I learned so much from the people from every walk of life who I found myself surrounded by. I also saw firsthand how the Black and brown people there had far longer sentences than their white peers. Affluence affects legal representation - some of the guys serving 10 to 15 years there would still probably be doing time but would have likely been doing way less time if they’d had adequate legal representation. From listening to my peers I also learned how in many cases their criminal acts didn’t happen in a vacuum but were instead influenced by many factors like education, poverty, family relationships and more. Prison and the experience of making a mistake and going through the criminal justice system provided me with a foundational learning experience that has made me a better listener, made me more empathetic, and has made me that much hungrier to fight for the voiceless. Now that I am a father it is my life’s mission to set a good example for my son and to give back to my community. When I got out in 2007 I found a vastly different financial landscape than what I had left. The 2008 crash and its leadup was devastating for the real estate and financial world - giant firms in my industry closed their doors, colleagues of mine committed suicide, and it seemed like the economy was on the brink. Despite this I managed to claw my way out and get back onto the track I was on pre-prison. Since then I helped to elect President Obama in 2008 getting out the vote for him across NYC, I worked to help elect Governor Andrew Cuomo, I’ve been appointed to boards by NYC Mayor Michael Bloomberg, became a partner at a real estate investment firm, and most importantly I am a father. | | | My son and I. | Now I am proudly launching my campaign for Congress in New York’s 4th Congressional district — one of the most flippable districts in the nation. My GOP opponent, Congressman Anthony D’Esposito (R-NY), campaigns about being tough on crime but when he was an officer with the NYPD he received numerous complaints, among them for excessive force, and was let go for abusing his power. Democrats held NY-04 for over 25 years, but that changed last year when we lost big in the district and throughout Long Island. I can flip NY-04 blue because I have the background and life experiences to connect with the moderate and independent voters who we lost last time. | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Thank you in advance for your support. body:
The cost of buying the 2024 election — so far.
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1069%2E62735%2EJj30ea)
**“Outside groups have dumped nearly $318 million into 2024...elections” — more than six times the amount spent through the same period in 2020.**
\- _The Hill_
* * *
Want to know how much it costs to buy an election, Peter? This cycle, ehhhhh...that’ll just cost you a modest **$318 million!!!** 😡😡😡
That’s how much deep-pocketed special interest groups — like Big Pharma and the NRA — have spent so far this election cycle. _And the problem is only going to get worse._
Why? **Because we have a broken campaign finance system propped up by bought-and-paid-for politicians who REFUSE to end _Citizens United_ and get money out of politics.**
Now, THIS is the status quo for our “leaders” in Washington:
1. **Meet with constituents** in the morning and promise you’re their top priority
2. **Meet with deep-pocketed, special-interest lobbyists** later that same day
3. **Vote in favor of lobbyists** that evening
4. **Rinse and repeat**

Peter, this is the “dark money conveyor belt” Hill has railed against from the moment he launched his campaign. It’s what’s allowed crooks like Mitch McConnell to stay in office for nearly 40 years and accomplish nothing for working families — all while the costs of education, housing, and everyday necessities climb higher and higher.
That’s why Hill is fighting to get money out of politics and put Washington back to work for the people. But the irony is that because of our broken campaign finance system, outsider candidates like Hill have to raise a LOT of grassroots money _just to have a shot_ against the Washington establishment.
So, it all boils down to this: **Unless we elect Hill to the Senate this year, we’ll continue being let down by greedy, career politicians who put profits over people in Washington — _just like the system was designed._**
**[Hill believes that PEOPLE, not special interest money, should determine elections. We know you do, too, so please: Chip in $318 million (_Just Kidding!_ We’re only asking for $5, $25, or whatever is right for you!) to send Hill to the Senate where he’ll flip the status quo and fix our broken system from the inside.](https://act.hillharper.com/go/745?t=2&akid=1069%2E62735%2EJj30ea)**

| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values.

After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty_?**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=81f59e991d9d4ba3a946ddc2857bb746&_e=NV7l-G8kl7hIDZT8_TjWGvqaJE6GGVGMotDHuaSmxVZv0VoFpEH0CDeeZ2-TcQRUjVRtp6pGYv2wFQEkcCYRMiROOKWc0FUSGZMnBBXGgQnjd80vcDY2-HPqU2gG4K-rcndI-B2U8mp3lGnmd0voVB4YcapBJ51tojLeel53oO2hkkQRa_TocjBLdN2EL0ITby296vA67gxRYTxKR_VBiyVy3SzmSEScnT1mUumFTXGYzGJ8UqY9uiabOzvxE9oNxz0f8srKZl21_4oTFyYA4mFY_47QW0VOQp4jzX59fOiq5Y-OqxtTdPO2RECLnsFAQNDVHm0Zr9B4QG9mbYYsZpPbSvXCe0tbhx3PgTkDNuFrOIPgIev2bYeXLR9bE4ofETP2JBkmbLjtENS6ZETKBF_SEKkLUAyA-tznrgM3Eic%3D)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values.**

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values,**are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=81f59e991d9d4ba3a946ddc2857bb746&_e=NV7l-G8kl7hIDZT8_TjWGvqaJE6GGVGMotDHuaSmxVZv0VoFpEH0CDeeZ2-TcQRUjVRtp6pGYv2wFQEkcCYRMiROOKWc0FUSGZMnBBXGgQnjd80vcDY2-HPqU2gG4K-rcndI-B2U8mp3lGnmd0voVB4YcapBJ51tojLeel53oO2hkkQRa_TocjBLdN2EL0ITby296vA67gxRYTxKR_VBiyVy3SzmSEScnT1mUumFTXGYzGJ8UqY9uiabOzvxE9oNqLO5e9t2oUQKPQ-jL-uU3TRlTYh1s2ScWHyugyXunb4AYsYfHHKkiapbCtQmT-pnHmT9PlGc-_T87XAbRazoah8OgE43fVqi1nWBVAYvYwxU4ch8QUKZnrbc_30sd9IrLTPvof1W7qkLDtqeOvUSoiHAV1ZOgNgEBYtQ5R0LxN0%3D)

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Another eventful week, marked by candidate forums, legislative wins, and important events. I'm thrilled to give you a glimpse into these key moments!

Friends and fellow Hoosiers,

This past week on the campaign trail has been nothing short of eventful, marked by candidate forums, legislative victories, and important gatherings. I'm thrilled to provide you with a glimpse into these key moments and accomplishments.

Let's hit the highlights!

** 🚨 WATCH AND SHARE 🚨 First Gubernatorial Debate Tonight!
------------------------------------------------------------

Tonight is the first gubernatorial debate (https://crouchforindiana.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db6332b918877c0167cdddb48&id=17c42aba1e&e=1a234020cb&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=b71f36c897-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_06_02_38&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-b71f36c897-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) ! I'm excited to share my message of delivering results for YOU. From axing the tax to protecting Hoosier land from China to investing in mental health, tonight, you'll see I'm the right candidate for the job.

FOLLOW and SHARE tonight's social media posts for the debate. Tag me in your post to help us amplify this critical message!
FOLLOW & SHARE ON FACEBOOK (https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=b71f36c897-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_06_02_38&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-b71f36c897-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

** ENDORSEMENTS BY THE NUMBERS: (https://crouchforindiana.com/endorsements/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=b71f36c897-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_06_02_38&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-b71f36c897-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) Law Enforcement
------------------------------------------------------------

I am deeply honored to be the only candidate who has been endorsed (https://crouchforindiana.com/endorsements/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=b71f36c897-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_06_02_38&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-b71f36c897-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) by more than two dozen law enforcement professionals, including sheriffs and prosecutors from across our great state!
https://crouchforindiana.com/endorsements/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=b71f36c897-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_06_02_38&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-b71f36c897-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

------------------------------------------------------------

I recently released my new TV ad, titled "A Time for Strength (https://fb.watch/qEptq7gvLe/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=b71f36c897-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_06_02_38&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-b71f36c897-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) ," and I need your help to ensure it reaches as many Hoosiers as possible.

** STATEMENT: Bill Limiting Foreign Ownership of Land (https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana/posts/pfbid02tAzY8suj8d9fwtg6vUNf4emZXmSgRtfpZHnFA6zYbTpmADEG9bvdw9YSUNTt6Wiyl?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=b71f36c897-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_06_02_38&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-b71f36c897-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------

As Secretary of Agriculture, I urged the Senate last week to pass HB 1183 (https://iga.in.gov/legislative/2024/bills/house/1183/details?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=b71f36c897-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_06_02_38&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-b71f36c897-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , a crucial bill aimed at prohibiting foreign adversaries from buying our farmland and land near military bases. It's imperative that we protect our national security and agricultural freedom.

I'm pleased to report that the bill has been passed out of the Senate after receiving approval from the House.

** SEEN ON SOCIAL: #AxeTheTax (https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana/posts/pfbid033rsvfc2BbLjSkkrvgBLCE2pQGsJiRkhns2MBMD53NSG1aZf7gdCLkwLERGZ3UBWHl?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=b71f36c897-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_06_02_38&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-b71f36c897-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------
Big problems demand bold solutions. Don't forget to tag me in your post to help spread the word even further! clean_body: The GOP would rather send money to private institutions. | Peter, North Carolina’s future leaders attend our public schools — just like Roy did. But Republican legislators would rather strip away funding from our state’s public education system and divert 4 billion dollars of taxpayer money to unaccountable and unregulated private schools through the use of school vouchers. Meanwhile, public school teachers in North Carolina are underpaid, and critical school programs are underfunded. | Peter, Roy knows just how hard our public school teachers work to give their students the quality education they deserve. Roy’s own mother was a North Carolina public school teacher! We have some of the best teachers in the nation — and some of the brightest young students.
