# End-of-Session Update from Senator Hunley
[](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMDYsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vaW5kaWFuYXNlbmF0ZWRlbW9jcmF0cy5vcmcvczQ2LyIsImJ1bGxldGluX2lkIjoiMjAyNDAzMTEuOTE2Mzg2NTEifQ.wbn_tZlxSqbXA9DnBfxtpyVHL0AlmDrucwisHH3tS-M/s/2950175210/br/238633163529-l)
---
It was a fast & furious nine weeks. We fought hard fights this session. Some we lost. Many, we won. All of it, we've done together. Serving as your senator & representing the heart of Indianapolis -- the beating heart of our state -- is my greatest joy.

Read on to learn about a few of our victories this session. I hope I'll keep hearing from you about the issues that matter & the problems you're facing. My office will help you navigate our state government and answer your questions, all year round.
**E: senator.hunley@iga.in.gov**
**P: 217.232.9491**
|
## [Lawmakers push bill to replace lead pipes](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMDcsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vc3RhdGVhZmZhaXJzLmNvbS9pbmRpYW5hL2hlYWx0aGNhcmUvc2VuYXRlLWJpbGwtNS1sZWFkLXNlcnZpY2UtbGluZXMvIiwiYnVsbGV0aW5faWQiOiIyMDI0MDMxMS45MTYzODY1MSJ9.xsbcBmOflbhzpk4T0olCZpyAM9DP_VGItAz5kNswNCc/s/2950175210/br/238633163529-l)
|
---
I'm proud to have successfully co-authored legislation to expedite the testing and replacement of lead pipes in Hoosier communities. I'm hopeful for a future where environmental lead exposure is a thing of the past, especially for our vulnerable children. We are a step closer to that future now that the Governor has signed our bill into law.
* * *
---
## [Language allowing chaplains into schools defeated](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMDgsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vd3d3LmNoYWxrYmVhdC5vcmcvaW5kaWFuYS8yMDI0LzAzLzA3L2NoYXBsYWlucy1wdWJsaWMtc2Nob29sLWNvdW5zZWxvcnMvIzp-OnRleHQ9SW5kaWFuYSUyMGxhd21ha2VycyUyMGhhdmUlMjBjdXQlMjBhLGluc3RydWN0aW9uJTIwYXQlMjB0aGVpciUyMHBhcmVudHMlMjclMjByZXF1ZXN0LiIsImJ1bGxldGluX2lkIjoiMjAyNDAzMTEuOTE2Mzg2NTEifQ.HcOWPs98LrMH8RBfs6RKg6RVfcrk3iP3JJt9MfPFIm4/s/2950175210/br/238633163529-l)
[](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMDksInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vaW5kaWFuYWNhcGl0YWxjaHJvbmljbGUuY29tLzIwMjQvMDMvMDYvc2VuYXRvcnMtc3Bhci1vdmVyLWxvb3Nlci10ZWVuYWdlLWxhYm9yLWxhd3MtcGx1cy1wZW5zaW9ucy1sYW5kLWJ1eXMtYW5kLW1vcmUvIiwiYnVsbGV0aW5faWQiOiIyMDI0MDMxMS45MTYzODY1MSJ9.SXM6OYmZ9K9dRtSEAYfddveJiUhxmkU2cFgEzLEYl34/s/2950175210/br/238633163529-l)
---
This session we managed to defeat -- multiple times -- language from the so-called "[chaplain bill](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMTAsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vaWdhLmluLmdvdi9sZWdpc2xhdGl2ZS8yMDI0L2JpbGxzL3NlbmF0ZS81MC9kZXRhaWxzIiwiYnVsbGV0aW5faWQiOiIyMDI0MDMxMS45MTYzODY1MSJ9.2yiPWUwe4EkEfqHH3p_Sknp2uTpA0y4oR90lSEQWydw/s/2950175210/br/238633163529-l)". Schools must be equipped to welcome students of all and no faith traditions. Our state should never employ religious leaders to serve as counselors in schools. I look forward to productive talks to address our school staffing shortage next session, but this bill was not a good approach and I am glad we fought it down.
## STORIES SHAPING OUR STATE
[13th Check for Public Retirees Secured](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMTEsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vaW5kaWFuYWNhcGl0YWxjaHJvbmljbGUuY29tLzIwMjQvMDMvMDgvaW5kaWFuYS1wdWJsaWMtcmV0aXJlZXMtd2luLTEzdGgtY2hlY2stYW5kLWd1YXJhbnRlZWQtZnV0dXJlLWJlbmVmaXQtYm9udXNlcy8iLCJidWxsZXRpbl9pZCI6IjIwMjQwMzExLjkxNjM4NjUxIn0.L5PFZMeGHBFw8dQ78ffql96GKsRF6zLYkgRdvEi85-M/s/2950175210/br/238633163529-l)
The House and Senate came to an agreement late Friday to finally get a 13th Check for retired public employees over the finish line. Retirees -- especially our teachers -- worked hard to earn their benefits and it's past time for us to give them the peace of mind they deserve.
[PFAs legislation dies, lives, and dies again ](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMTIsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vaW5kaWFuYWNhcGl0YWxjaHJvbmljbGUuY29tL2JyaWVmcy9jb250cm92ZXJzaWFsLXBmYXMtZGVmaW5pdGlvbi1jaGFuZ2UtbGVmdC1vdXQtb2YtaW5kaWFuYS1iaWxsLXRoYXQtbm93LWhlYWRzLXRvLWdvdmVybm9ycy1kZXNrLyIsImJ1bGxldGluX2lkIjoiMjAyNDAzMTEuOTE2Mzg2NTEifQ.aQ5Uy4BulaZrWs9DCub4ax8_wtveWGgqwrUM9C-Wqw4/s/2950175210/br/238633163529-l)

It's the way of the legislature to revive bills that didn't make it through their initial hearings, especially when things get down to the wire. Late last week we saw this play out with legislation that would have redefined certain PFAs -- toxic forever chemicals -- as safe-for-sale and use in Indiana. Thankfully a vigilant public and hard-working legislators were on the case, and now that session is over it's safe to say that bill is dead for this year.
[Indiana lawmakers move bill to fund research on magic mushrooms for mental health treatment](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMTMsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vd3d3LmluZHlzdGFyLmNvbS9zdG9yeS9uZXdzL3BvbGl0aWNzLzIwMjQvMDEvMTcvbWFnaWMtbXVzaHJvb21zLWZvci1kZXByZXNzaW9uLWluZGlhbmEtY29uc2lkZXJzLWJpbGwtdG8tZnVuZC1yZXNlYXJjaC83MjI1NDcyMDAwNy8iLCJidWxsZXRpbl9pZCI6IjIwMjQwMzExLjkxNjM4NjUxIn0.265SA8HwOFu5ceErtn8ES7V8xiC9JACqQf1aZOxtXxM/s/2950175210/br/238633163529-l)
A last-minute development Friday commits state funding to researching the clinical potential of psilocybin. I am excited about the opportunity to bring a new treatment option to communities that struggle with complex mental health issues, particularly our Hoosier veterans who spoke out strongly in favor of this legislation.

clean_body: | | | | | "Twitter" "Twitter" "Facebook"mailto:s46@iga.in.gov "Email" "Visit Me Online" | End-of-Session Update from Senator Hunley It was a fast & furious nine weeks. We fought hard fights this session. Some we lost. Many, we won. All of it, we've done together. Serving as your senator & representing the heart of Indianapolis -- the beating heart of our state -- is my greatest joy. Read on to learn about a few of our victories this session. I hope I'll keep hearing from you about the issues that matter & the problems you're facing. My office will help you navigate our state government and answer your questions, all year round. E: senator.hunley@iga.in.gov P: 217.232.9491 | | I'm proud to have successfully co-authored legislation to expedite the testing and replacement of lead pipes in Hoosier communities. I'm hopeful for a future where environmental lead exposure is a thing of the past, especially for our vulnerable children. We are a step closer to that future now that the Governor has signed our bill into law. This session we managed to defeat -- multiple times -- language from the so-called "". Schools must be equipped to welcome students of all and no faith traditions. Our state should never employ religious leaders to serve as counselors in schools. I look forward to productive talks to address our school staffing shortage next session, but this bill was not a good approach and I am glad we fought it down. STORIES SHAPING OUR STATE The House and Senate came to an agreement late Friday to finally get a 13th Check for retired public employees over the finish line. Retirees -- especially our teachers -- worked hard to earn their benefits and it's past time for us to give them the peace of mind they deserve. It's the way of the legislature to revive bills that didn't make it through their initial hearings, especially when things get down to the wire. Late last week we saw this play out with legislation that would have redefined certain PFAs -- toxic forever chemicals -- as safe-for-sale and use in Indiana. Thankfully a vigilant public and hard-working legislators were on the case, and now that session is over it's safe to say that bill is dead for this year. A last-minute development Friday commits state funding to researching the clinical potential of psilocybin. I am excited about the opportunity to bring a new treatment option to communities that struggle with complex mental health issues, particularly our Hoosier veterans who spoke out strongly in favor of this legislation. | COMMUNITY RESOURCES To view my state government resource guide, "Hunley Community Resource Guide". | | | | | Created and distributed by the Indiana Senate Democratic Communications Office Shenetha.Shepherd@iga.in.gov Kyle.Casteel@iga.in.gov Molly.Neary@iga.in.gov ---|---|--- SUBSCRIBER SERVICES: | | | *

subject: FRACK JOE MANCHIN
body:
| | | | |
---
This is Matthew. I am a 21-year-old bicycle-maker and a volunteer for Climate Defiance. We’re the new, youth-led, insurgent arm of the climate movement.
If you’re just tuning in: we’re the group that goes hard. We blockaded the White House Correspondents Dinner and sowed CHAOS at the Congressional Softball Game. We’ve shut down keynotes and galas and luncheons honoring too many senators and cabinet members to count.
We’re just one year old and we’ve already been profiled in the [New Republic](https://climatedefiance.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7fefc94cc382f198de064b36&id=f4f1085ec3&e=c0a1c11fc3), the [Guardian](https://climatedefiance.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7fefc94cc382f198de064b36&id=91ca1afa67&e=c0a1c11fc3), the [NYT](https://climatedefiance.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7fefc94cc382f198de064b36&id=97691d5740&e=c0a1c11fc3), [InsideClimateNews](https://climatedefiance.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7fefc94cc382f198de064b36&id=42e256d0d1&e=c0a1c11fc3), and [Rolling Stone](https://climatedefiance.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7fefc94cc382f198de064b36&id=83ef8cbaed&e=c0a1c11fc3).
I’m writing to let you know what I did last week.
I stood face to face with Joe Manchin and let him know that he is a sick fuck. His Exxon lobbyist henchman threw me to the ground, but I got back up. I can promise you that as long as I am able to stand I will continue to get back up to fight those who have built their fortunes by destroying our futures.
You can see it all unfold on [CNN](https://climatedefiance.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7fefc94cc382f198de064b36&id=ebbc5d5f1c&e=c0a1c11fc3).
When we walked into the Harvard campus I was nervous, but we had a mission. We navigated the maze of the building until we realized we were directly above the room where Joe Manchin was speaking off the record to a bunch of Harvard students.
We silently coordinated and I led us down a staircase. We were prepared to be confronted by security; instead there was only a locked door in our way. When we knocked, the door was opened...and there was Joe Manchin - just five feet in front of me. While I told the whole room how Manchin has accepted more money from the Fossil Fuel Industry than anyone else in the Senate, my fellow disruptors slid in through the door. While shocked students looked on I called Joe Manchin what he is: A SICK FUCK!
He squared up with me and for a moment I thought I was going to be punched by a U.S. Senator. Instead his former aid, now private sector fossil fuel lobbyist Johnathan Kott pushed me into the door and out the room. It didn’t matter though. I had gotten my point across.
While I was keeping Kott and a Harvard Police Detective occupied outside the room, my friends were confronting Manchin about his forcing of the Mountain Valley Pipeline through West Virginia and sacred Indigenous burial grounds.
The Mountain Valley pipeline will carry 2 billion cubic feet of fracked gas across more than a thousand streams and wetlands from Northwestern West Virginia to Southern Virginia unless WE stop it. Over 750 frontline communities and environmental justice organizations oppose its construction.This pipeline has a horrific safety track record. It has received 55 notices of violation – 46 of those were for violating water quality standards. They even got a $300,000 fine from the WV EPA for erosion and sedimentation. If built, it would endanger many of West Virginia’s most cherished rivers.
When confronted with this, what did Manchin do? He doubled down on his support for the pipeline saying that West Virginians, which includes some of the most impoverished, exploited, and environmentally vulnerable communities in the US, should SUPPORT the pipeline. This is an outrage. Joe Manchin doesn’t represent West Virginians. He represents the fossil fuel industry. He knows it and we know it. Now the 5.7 million people who have seen the viral [confrontation](https://climatedefiance.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7fefc94cc382f198de064b36&id=f89a1d12ce&e=c0a1c11fc3) know it too.
I wasn’t planning on participating in this action. I was scheduled to work that day and didn’t want to make the trip to Boston. But a week ago I was standing in a crowded home in Somerville and I listened to Representative Ayanna Preslley speak about the incredible effect the work of Climate Defiance has had, as well as the infuriating environmental injustices happening just a few miles from us. She invoked the words of Angela Davis: “I am no longer accepting the things I cannot change, I am changing the things I cannot accept.” These words inspired me to make a commitment. I donated $1000 to Climate Defiance and committed to attend this action to confront Manchin. Now I am bruised, and I am tired, but dammit I am satisfied because I know I did what is necessary and what is right.
A study from the Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health determined that 1 in 5 deaths are caused by pollution. I am committed to tracking down those who are responsible for this ecocide and letting the world know what they have done. But this is not free. Pulling off these actions cost real money. I personally donated $1000 because we need widespread, hard-hitting, frequent, disruptive direct action to turn this crisis around. Can you match my $1K gift? If you are not in a position to do so, can you give any amount that is meaningful to you? You can do so [here](https://climatedefiance.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f7fefc94cc382f198de064b36&id=c9831568fb&e=c0a1c11fc3).
In Solidarity, Matthew

It’s Jane here, and I’ve got something important to share with you. Last month, thanks to all of you, we raised just over $78,000 for the Jane Fonda Climate PAC from emails just like this one. I’m blown away by the support and dedication of every single one of you who reads our emails and chips in your hard-earned dollars. **But here’s the deal: We need to up the ante. With just a few weeks until our next quarterly deadline, we’ve set an ambitious goal to nearly double our February grassroots fundraising haul to $150,000.** Why now? After Super Tuesday, many states have decided on their nominees for November, and this is the time when big spending kicks in from outside groups and the fossil fuel industry. **FREDERICK, MD** – Republican candidate for Maryland’s Sixth Congressional District, Dr. Mariela Roca, has been officially endorsed by former Speaker of the House of Representatives, Newt Gingrich. Speaker Gingrich visited the district last October and hosted a fundraising event in support of Dr. Roca. Today, our campaign is proud and honored to receive this endorsement from Speaker Gingrich, who with his “Contract with America” led the Republican Party to victory in 1994 by capturing the majority in the U.S. House of Representatives for the first time in forty years.
“Mariela Roca is exactly the right person to represent Maryland’s 6th District in the U.S. House of Representatives. I met her several months ago and was immediately impressed with her authenticity, attitude, and achievements. Mariela is a strong conservative, an Air Force veteran, and a devoted mother. She is running for Congress to bring down costs for families, secure our border, and fight to protect our unalienable, God-given rights. I encourage every voter in Maryland’s 6th District who cares about creating a better future for our country to support Mariela Roca for Congress. We need her in the House, and she has my full endorsement.”
Mariela continues to stand out as the only Republican candidate in this race to garner multiple endorsements for the 2024 election from various elected officials and organizations, solidifying her position as the frontrunner and the only candidate with the credibility to secure victory for Republicans in Maryland and help the GOP keep our house majority. Her ability to secure the trust and support of notable elected officials and organizations underscores that she is the only Republican candidate who has what it takes to win this seat back for Republicans in November. Dr. Roca is thrilled to add Speaker Gingrich’s endorsement to her growing list of official endorsements.
Maryland Republicans are prepared to broaden their leadership base within our state, and Dr. Roca stands as the only promising GOP in this race that can do just that. # More about Mariela Roca
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=a2daf64cb3&e=0a12281e0e)
My name is Mariela Roca. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for Congress here in Maryland’s 6th Congressional District.
[**Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution to help boost my campaign’s momentum and WIN BACK Maryland’s 6th Congressional District!**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=a0aad5fa02&e=0a12281e0e)
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=6069710053&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for Congress because I was raised by a single mom in Puerto Rico who always showed me how hard work and determination is what makes us all live the American dream. I learned english when I was 5 years old, and from that young age always felt so proud to be an American.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=b0d2c5e0d7&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for Congress as a military veteran. I began my journey of service to our nation in 2005 when I joined the U.S. Air Force at the age of 20. During my military service I had the honor of serving my county abroad in the Global War on Terror, serving within the Task Force Medical and the Bagram Theater Internment Facility (BTIF) in Bagram, Afghanistan, during Operation Enduring Freedom in 2007. I know what sacrifice looks like - and this is why I love my country so much.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=31ce1e3a72&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for my kids, your kids, and your grandkids. Everything that I do in my life is to make the best possible future for my daughter and my son and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has offered me my entire life.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=cc53b69605&e=0a12281e0e)
[**I’M RUNNING FOR CONGRESS BECAUSE WE HAVE A COUNTRY TO SAVE!**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=f4205251dd&e=0a12281e0e)
Even during our most challenging moments, we are fortunate to call America our home. But it's clear that under the Biden administration, we face significant challenges, our prospects are dwindling, we are weak on the world stage, our economy is failing, and American families are being left behind every single day.
[**I’m running for Congress because America can do better with leaders that will always fight for America first. No matter what.**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=52ecf8e0a8&e=0a12281e0e)
**As a military veteran** , I intimately understand the profound significance of service and the willingness to make the ultimate sacrifice for my country. My time in the military taught me the unwavering commitment to duty, honor, and the defense of freedom. It's a bond that transcends words; a deep-seated connection with the men and women I served alongside, many of whom paid the ultimate price. I've witnessed the selflessness, courage, and dedication that define the character of those who choose to protect their nation.
**As a medical logistician** , my mission was to ensure that our dedicated warfighters had the essential tools and supplies required to save lives on the frontlines. I understood the critical nature of my role in providing our troops with the medical resources and equipment they needed to deliver immediate care in challenging and high-stress situations. I am now prepared to take the knowledge, commitment, and understanding I gained in that role with me to Congress, where I will tirelessly advocate for policies that will support our country, military and American families first. Above anything.
**As a** **mother** , I understand firsthand the deep commitment and love that comes with the responsibility of providing for one's family. In the countless roles we take on as parents - caregiver, protector, educator, and provider - we become intimately acquainted with the challenges and triumphs of family life. We witness the struggles that many families face, whether it's making ends meet, securing access to quality education, or ensuring our children have the healthcare they need. It's in these moments that we are inspired to take action, to advocate for better opportunities, and to fight for a brighter future for our families.
I know how to make our community, district, and America strong and proud because i’ve done it before.
[**And i’ll do it again as your next Congresswoman.**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=622208a3b4&e=0a12281e0e)
As your next Congresswoman for Maryland’s 6th Congressional District I will always fight for policies that will revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s out of control spending, champion school choice & parental rights, and save America’s future.
But, in order to do this, I need your support today so I can spread this message to everyone across our district and country.
[**Will you chip in today to help me win this fight for our nation’s future?**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=2a55f0a133&e=0a12281e0e)
Together we WILL flip Maryland’s 6th Congressional District for Republicans and make America strong and proud again.
Sincerely,

name: Ilhan Omar
subject: Ramadan Mubarak
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
As we begin this holy month, may this be a time of reflection, compassion, and community.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1007%2E791427%2EMoqaK2)

Friend,
For almost two billion Muslims worldwide, this week marks the beginning of Ramadan, the holiest month of the year. I wanted to take a moment today to reach out and wish my neighbors here in Minnesota and Muslims around the world a safe, peaceful, and blessed Ramadan.
To me, Ramadan means fasting and prayer, charity and forgiveness, and is a time especially for reflection and renewal.
Each year I look forward to reflecting on the blessings I have received, reminding myself of the struggle faced by those less fortunate, and considering how I can help make the world a better place through service to my community.
But while Ramadan is meant to be a time of great joy, the reality for Muslims across the globe is that this year's festivities are marred by the conflict in Sudan, the oppression of Uyghur Muslims in China, the persecution of Rohingya in Myanmar, the escalating war in Gaza, and the ongoing brutalization and suffering of our Palestinian brothers and sisters.
I pray especially for the people of Rafah, where more than 1 million civilian refugees have faced intensified bombings and airstrikes at the hands of Israel, who have vowed to press on with their invasion despite continued calls for a ceasefire during this holy month.
Whether you celebrate or not, I hope that with the start of Ramadan our movement may share this time of reflection, and reaffirm a commitment towards our common humanity by building a more just and peaceful world for all.
With love and in solidarity, Ramadan Mubarak.
\- Ilhan

body:
[1]Powered By People

Here’s what Powered by People is working on this week:

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Debunking right-wing immigration myths

In court, Texas is trying to shut down a legal immigration program that
Presiden Biden has used to reduce unauthorized crossings. There are a
slate of false, right-wing claims about the program going viral, so I want
to make sure you have the facts:

The program, called “humanitarian parole,” allows certain migrants to live
and work in the U.S. for two years. People have to apply from abroad, be
properly vetted, pay for their own travel, and prove that they will be
financially stable in the U.S.

After President Biden used his congressionally authorized authority to
expand the program last year, it proved that safe, legal immigration
pathways are key to improving border security: illegal crossings from
eligible countries [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/62998?source=ema20240311-239513&t=1001&akid=239513%2E444211%2EOeI52E ]dropped by over 90%.

Donald Trump and others are spreading [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/62999?source=ema20240311-239513&t=1002&akid=239513%2E444211%2EOeI52E ]false claims that the program is
illegal, and that President Biden is “secretly” flying criminals into the
country using taxpayer dollars. Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton has
filed a lawsuit to kill the program — and while a [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/63000?c0=20240311.AhQcYK&c1=239513.lyHnyb&t=1003&akid=239513%2E444211%2EOeI52E ]federal judge
dismissed the case on Friday, Paxton is expected to appeal.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/63001?source=ema20240311-239513&t=1004&akid=239513%2E444211%2EOeI52E ]As the case moves through the courts, here is a resource you can share
with others that debunks the GOP’s claims about the humanitarian parole
program.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Keeping hope after the Texas primaries

It’s clear from last week’s primary results that the Texas legislature
could soon lurch even further to the right. [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/63002?t=1005&akid=239513%2E444211%2EOeI52E'%20campaign%20money.?source=ema20240311-239513 ]Far-right billionaires
poured millions into Texas House races to prop up GOP candidates who —
among other things — vow to defund public schools and advance the
Christian Nationalist movement in Texas.

But here’s the silver lining in all of this:

Some of these new GOP candidates are so extreme that the threat they pose
may help Democrats flip some Texas House seats in the general election. In
addition, three of the most competitive U.S. House races are right here in
Texas, and we have a real shot at defeating Ted Cruz this year.

It’s more important than ever that we keep the faith and put in the work
to change the trajectory of our state.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Registering and organizing voters

There are a slate of false, right-wing claims about the program going viral, so I want to make sure you have the facts: The program, called “humanitarian parole,” allows certain migrants to live and work in the U.S. for two years. People have to apply from abroad, be properly vetted, pay for their own travel, and prove that they will be financially stable in the U.S. After President Biden used his congressionally authorized authority to expand the program last year, it proved that safe, legal immigration pathways are key to improving border security: illegal crossings from eligible countries [ ]dropped by over 90%. ---|---|---
For much of the past thirty years, the global business environment has been driven by economics. As nations stumbled over themselves to enter a global economy that offered enormous markets, economists and business consultants preached the logic of gains from trade, the concept of competitive advantage, and the promise that a world with less barriers was one in which a rising economic tide would lift all national boats. Businesses faced a tailwind of less protectionism and friction in conducting global commerce. For better or worse, that world no longer exists.
_**The global business environment today is increasingly driven by geopolitics**_ and the [great power war being waged between China and the United States](https://substack.com/redirect/07112eb1-4b49-46aa-817c-54f45fcfaff4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Leaders in virtually every industry need to acknowledge this reality and adapt to the shifting environment. Countries need to recognize that the global economy is splitting into two ecosystems -- one led by the United States and its Western allies and the other led by China, Russia, Iran and North Korea -- and they'll be forced to pick sides. (And if they don't, there could a further fracturing of the global economy into regional blocs and "spheres of influence" that will create an extremely disjointed business environment for multinational companies.) The days of relying on US military protection while profiting from trade with China are numbered. This doesn't mean that countries like India won't try to play both sides. After all, they've been historically aligned with Russia but competitive with China...which makes for an awkward relationship triangle as China and Russia get closer.
Unfortunately, all of these dynamics will lead to less (if any) cooperation on addressing some of the planet's greatest challenges as [multilateral institutions prove increasingly useless](https://substack.com/redirect/b915d7d6-de93-45e9-a63e-5dabe8e8af36?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Thinking about the world as having one economy is rapidly emerging as an antiquated concept. Despite this increasing fragmentation, disruptions can rapidly spread from one area of the world to another.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5e899a59-211f-41a8-90a1-00abeadc5555?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Photo by [Luis Villasmil](https://substack.com/redirect/e7bbda44-cb36-4d50-9cff-0d012770e192?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on [Unsplash](https://substack.com/redirect/bf4d1011-1226-4a6d-b00a-956b741c4882?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Just think about [the Israel-Hamas conflict ](https://substack.com/redirect/7edc82c9-6014-4907-990c-c82256b13cc0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)and how it has generated a social fissure in the United States, disrupting not only America's leading education institutions but also [Israeli companies operating in the United States](https://substack.com/redirect/ad0fd617-857d-4f7b-afbf-7c52b82baa89?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Or how [the Russia-Ukraine war continues to increase supply uncertainty in agriculture and fertilizer markets](https://substack.com/redirect/b0d0b65f-4122-4dec-a556-677979806120?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Or how might [escalating tensions between Venezuela and Guyana impact oil markets and inflation pressure in energy-intensive industries](https://substack.com/redirect/aadbaaeb-29fa-4def-8eb8-4362763ddd55?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)?
One of the most obvious implications of this accelerating global fragmentation is that geopolitics is trumping economics as a driver of the business environment. Economics has handed the baton of business risk to geopolitics. The clearest manifestation of this dynamic is in the **geography of supply chains and manufacturing**. Offshoring (based on economics) is being replaced with friendshoring (based on geopolitics) or onshoring (based on domestic politics). One of the main beneficiaries of this trend is Mexico, a country that has seen inbound foreign direct investment and exports to the United States surge. In fact, [the Port of Laredo was the number one point of entry for American bound goods last year](https://substack.com/redirect/c8b8d03a-e256-43fe-9402-2e8d696343b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| | POLL

Do you think the United States and China can decouple their economies?
| [Yes, process underway](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9tYW5zaGFyYW1hbmkuc3Vic3RhY2suY29tL2FwaS92MS9wb2xsL3ZvdGUvZW1haWw_.e5k0qWZyHn5C4sKwuXVZIB59p6iF6B06zdouNGmCK3Y?)
---
[Partially but not completely](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9tYW5zaGFyYW1hbmkuc3Vic3RhY2suY29tL2FwaS92MS9wb2xsL3ZvdGUvZW1haWw_.t7gJ_K0wUy4f-ME2uVSScKBg4aBHG1t2zNzFXACUlSA?)
[No, we're too interconnected](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9tYW5zaGFyYW1hbmkuc3Vic3RhY2suY29tL2FwaS92MS9wb2xsL3ZvdGUvZW1haWw_.d4__LRuCRbySieEC3AYWI5pawcRbf73ecFggGb3sZUs?)
Consider also how geopolitics is impacting**shipping and the movement of goods** across the world. As Iran-backed Houthi rebels continue to attack ships in the Red Sea, shipping patterns are shifting rapidly. In the first two months of 2024, for instance, Suez Canal trade dropped by more than 50%. Let's not forget that approximately 15% of global trade has historically transited through the Suez Canal as it's a primary sea lane for Europe-bound Asian exports. When combined with [decreased capacity at the Panama Canal](https://substack.com/redirect/476aa573-9633-416b-ba70-71fe6cf98ea1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), it's not surprising that shipping rates have surged. What might the impact be on global inflation, and how [might inflation change the voting behavior](https://substack.com/redirect/ba831408-d107-4318-91ea-691c12121789?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of [citizens as they head to polls this year](https://substack.com/redirect/f41043ff-f422-4ccc-8c42-365e6d2451bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)?
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/565f415c-8b42-4108-9fa2-df6affb7358c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Source: [https://www.imf.org/en/Blogs/Articles/2024/03/07/Red-Sea-Attacks-Disrupt-Global-Trade](https://substack.com/redirect/b96292c4-6495-4957-b5b6-a11d21575963?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Geopolitics is also starting to impact **the safety of personnel** at US companies operating in countries such as China. [In May 2023, the Chinese government raided the Beijing offices of Mintz, an American due diligence firm, and held five local employees](https://substack.com/redirect/489593b7-6ce9-4f89-a039-e427cd56b21b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). [Boston-based Bain & Company noted that it too had been the target of the Chinese government and that employees in the firm's Shanghai office were under investigation](https://substack.com/redirect/152d3ed6-2026-471a-bdc8-da05eaafc99c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). And last September, [Michael Chan, a Managing Director at US risk consultancy Kroll, informed his employer that he was blocked from leaving the Chinese mainland](https://substack.com/redirect/2da0447e-da1a-41ed-aa76-116931ba35b6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). And that's just in China. How many senior American business leaders are willing to take an assignment in Moscow?
| | POLL

Does geopolitics impact the safety of personnel?
| [Absolutely, I'm not going to Moscow](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9tYW5zaGFyYW1hbmkuc3Vic3RhY2suY29tL2FwaS92MS9wb2xsL3ZvdGUvZW1haWw_.Vcx4WHju3lmNw0ZQeO3Vj1NnL2mQAFHmMgORiriY9gc?)

[Unclear, need to watch and see](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9tYW5zaGFyYW1hbmkuc3Vic3RhY2suY29tL2FwaS92MS9wb2xsL3ZvdGUvZW1haWw_.XwwBiYeup-RuEVx55VRkCKMVIcY1LbT_k64Id2_MfXk?)
### _Navigating Geopolitical Uncertainty_
Geopolitical uncertainty is an increasingly important factor in today's business environment. Management teams and corporate boards need to consciously think about global affairs and how they might create risks or generate opportunities.
This means spending more time on scenario planning and identifying risks that will inevitably surface from geopolitical disruptions. For instance, how might a Chinese military takeover of Taiwan impact the semiconductor industry and send ripples towards other industries? Will a semiconductor chip shortage create bottlenecks in a supplier's supplier's supplier? Or how might countries dependent upon wheat imports from Ukraine be at risk of social unrest as food riots spread? What will political shifts in these countries mean for foreign businesses with local operations? But let's not forget that uncertainty and risk create lots of opportunities. Might American farmers find opportunity in exporting to Eastern Europe? Or could US semiconductor companies spot growth opportunities in Australia?
Today's world is increasingly interconnected and demands that business leaders think about risk in an integrated manner. This means connecting the dots across politics, technology, demographics, economics, and increasingly **geopolitics**.
| | POLL
---
How important will geopolitics be for business over the next 10 years or so?
| [Very important, new paradigm](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9tYW5zaGFyYW1hbmkuc3Vic3RhY2suY29tL2FwaS92MS9wb2xsL3ZvdGUvZW1haWw_.EjyMcmDWg6DGfHzxl3cykaXQ53vUUKHHyBWo2SnL_6c?)

The global business environment has a new driver | | | Mar 11 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- For much of the past thirty years, the global business environment has been driven by economics. As nations stumbled over themselves to enter a global economy that offered enormous markets, economists and business consultants preached the logic of gains from trade, the concept of competitive advantage, and the promise that a world with less barriers was one in which a rising economic tide would lift all national boats. Businesses faced a tailwind of less protectionism and friction in conducting global commerce. For better or worse, that world no longer exists. The global business environment today is increasingly driven by geopolitics and the . Leaders in virtually every industry need to acknowledge this reality and adapt to the shifting environment. Countries need to recognize that the global economy is splitting into two ecosystems -- one led by the United States and its Western allies and the other led by China, Russia, Iran and North Korea -- and they'll be forced to pick sides. (And if they don't, there could a further fracturing of the global economy into regional blocs and "spheres of influence" that will create an extremely disjointed business environment for multinational companies.) The days of relying on US military protection while profiting from trade with China are numbered. This doesn't mean that countries like India won't try to play both sides. After all, they've been historically aligned with Russia but competitive with China...which makes for an awkward relationship triangle as China and Russia get closer. Unfortunately, all of these dynamics will lead to less (if any) cooperation on addressing some of the planet's greatest challenges as . Thinking about the world as having one economy is rapidly emerging as an antiquated concept. Despite this increasing fragmentation, disruptions can rapidly spread from one area of the world to another. | | ---|---|--- Photo by on Just think about how it has generated a social fissure in the United States, disrupting not only America's leading education institutions but also . Or how . Or how might ? One of the most obvious implications of this accelerating global fragmentation is that geopolitics is trumping economics as a driver of the business environment. Economics has handed the baton of business risk to geopolitics. The clearest manifestation of this dynamic is in the geography of supply chains and manufacturing. Offshoring (based on economics) is being replaced with friendshoring (based on geopolitics) or onshoring (based on domestic politics). One of the main beneficiaries of this trend is Mexico, a country that has seen inbound foreign direct investment and exports to the United States surge. In fact, . | | POLL Do you think the United States and China can decouple their economies? | ? ? ? Consider also how geopolitics is impactingshipping and the movement of goods across the world. As Iran-backed Houthi rebels continue to attack ships in the Red Sea, shipping patterns are shifting rapidly. In the first two months of 2024, for instance, Suez Canal trade dropped by more than 50%. Navigating Geopolitical Uncertainty Geopolitical uncertainty is an increasingly important factor in today's business environment. Management teams and corporate boards need to consciously think about global affairs and how they might create risks or generate opportunities. This means spending more time on scenario planning and identifying risks that will inevitably surface from geopolitical disruptions. For instance, how might a Chinese military takeover of Taiwan impact the semiconductor industry and send ripples towards other industries? Will a semiconductor chip shortage create bottlenecks in a supplier's supplier's supplier? Or how might countries dependent upon wheat imports from Ukraine be at risk of social unrest as food riots spread? What will political shifts in these countries mean for foreign businesses with local operations? But let's not forget that uncertainty and risk create lots of opportunities. Might American farmers find opportunity in exporting to Eastern Europe? Or could US semiconductor companies spot growth opportunities in Australia? Today's world is increasingly interconnected and demands that business leaders think about risk in an integrated manner. Friend,

I just recently returned from my fifth trip to Ukraine since the start of Russia’s savage, murderous invasion two years ago. Each visit has taught me so much about Ukrainian courage and resolve, and highlighted why continued American support is absolutely necessary.

Let me press this upon you: Ukraine is at a life-and-death moment. President Zelenskyy personally told me and my colleagues that without the arms and ammunition that the United States can provide, his lines cannot hold. Putin will conquer Ukraine. And he will not stop there.

Right now, Ukrainians are bleeding and dying, many because they lack enough ammunition to defend themselves. What happens if Congress stalls? What happens if we allow Ukraine to fall? Putin will advance to claim other nations and America could get pulled even further into violent conflict in Europe.
**We can avoid direct American involvement as well as protect Ukraine and enable them to win by passing the National Security Supplemental through the House and sending it to President Biden’s desk.**
This supplemental spending package provides the tools Ukraine needs most urgently: air defense, anti-mine systems, long-range artillery, and more. Yet Republican Speaker of the House Mike Johnson is sitting on the legislation and refusing to pass it – despite bipartisan support from the Senate, despite Ukraine being at a life-and-death moment right now.
**Speaker Johnson must lead or get out of the way. House members are ready to pass this legislation in droves, with an overwhelming bipartisan majority. I’m counting on this grassroots team to demand Speaker Johnson take action. **

subject: Governor Mike DeWine & First Lady Fran DeWine Endorse Matt Dolan for U.S. Senate.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY DOLAN FOR OHIO
body:
|
---
**Mike & Fran DeWine ** **2587 Conley Road** **Cedarville, OH 45314

** ★★★★★

March 11, 2024

To Our Fellow Ohioans, Today, Fran and I are endorsing Matt Dolan to be the Republican nominee in the race for the United States Senate. We believe this proven conservative is the strongest candidate to beat Sherrod Brown in the fall. Matt's service, experience, and integrity will make him the most effective voice for Ohio's interests on the national stage. He cares deeply about the future of our state and nation. He is determined to protect America here at home and abroad, and he knows that nothing is more important to our security than a strong national defense. Matt Dolan has a vision for the future. He listens. He fights. And, he knows how to get results for Ohio. We have worked to bring business to Ohio and to create an environment in this state that will continue to grow jobs and keep Ohio moving forward. Matt has been a real partner to make Ohio a national leader in economic growth, job creation, and innovation. He is fighting and winning to bring jobs to Ohio and secure a prosperous economic future for our children and grandchildren. Despite the progress we're making here in Ohio, our nation continues to face a profound series of crises. From a migrant surge on our southern border to high prices, rising debt, and persistent provocations from Russia and China, this moment calls for public leaders guided by their conservative ideals, the Constitution, their convictions, and their commitment to getting things done. As a former county prosecutor, I know what Matt's experience as a tough-on-crime prosecutor means for our communities. He has repeatedly demonstrated an unwavering commitment to the people of Ohio, and his vision for a stronger, safer, more prosperous country consistently aligns with the goals of conservative leaders across Ohio. # Take your Health Back!
Alright, everybody, strap in because I've got something absolutely mind-blowing to share with you, especially all my folks in California and the surrounding areas. This is not your average health benefit – we're talking about a game-changer!
Now, I've been through the wringer when it comes to health. Yeah, I shed a whopping 500 pounds recently, but guess what? The battle's far from over. My body's still screaming in pain, and I'm staring down the barrel of two knee replacements. Back and hips? They're on a constant pain playlist, and the list of issues just keeps growing.
So, what do you do when the traditional pharmaceutical game doesn't cut it? You dig deep, you research, and you look for alternatives. And let me tell you, my skepticism led me to a revelation that's going to blow your minds!
About a month back, my buddy of 20 years, Pastor James Fortune, hit me up with news that changed the game for him and his wife, Canada. They discovered a treatment so good, it sounds too good to be true. But hold on – it's legit! We're talking medical documents, x-rays, blood tests – the whole nine yards.
I practically dragged Pastor James Fortune to Los Angeles because I knew you needed to hear this. We're hosting him at not one, but two locations in LA County. Picture this: an amazing catered dinner on us, and all the info you need to make educated decisions about taking charge of your health and living your absolute best life right now.
Don't procrastinate until your body breaks down even more. It's time to restore your youth, break free from the pain, and live the life you've been dreaming of. This is your shot, my friends – seize it!

$5, one time.
That is the donation we are asking you to make to Elissa Slotkin's campaign for Senate in Michigan today.
A few short hours ago, Donald Trump just endorsed Republican candidate Mike Rogers in our Senate race. We'll look back at this moment as a major inflection point in our race, and one where Elissa needs your help if we're going to win.

[Alexandria and the WFP are building a multiracial coalition to fight for workers over bosses and people over the powerful. Peter,

It is an honor to represent the City of Destiny as Mayor. I love Tacoma and care deeply about making sure our city is vibrant and strong. I love our people, and I get the privilege of working every day to improve our communities and respond to our challenges.

The challenge that I hear the most about is the lack of affordable housing in every neighborhood. This is a crisis that impacts us all, and it demands immediate action – _**both locally and at the national level.**_ We need leaders who can think creatively and strategically to make progress.

I believe Hilary Franz is that leader. It’s why I have proudly joined our congressman in supporting her campaign for Washington's 6th Congressional District. Hilary understands the urgency of our housing crisis and is committed to getting the results we desperately need.

Her track record speaks volumes. Too often in government, folks will look at an issue, throw up their hands and say, “that’s not our lane,” or “we’ve never done that before.”

Not Hilary. She looked at the housing crisis in our state and made the Department of Natural Resources a partner in affordable housing for the first time ever by using state-owned lands to build housing. In Congress, she will have even more ability to address our housing shortage and ensure everyone has a roof over their head and a place to call home.

I believe her leadership and vision are exactly what we need in Congress to tackle the housing crisis and so much more head-on.

_**[But she can't do it alone. Hilary needs our support to bring about real change. Will you join me in supporting Hilary Franz for WA-06 by contributing $5, $10, or whatever you can afford to her campaign today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80776101/460345603/-1503679382?refcode=BLU_EM_HFFC_2024-03-11_1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDA1NzQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiM2ZlNjg4ZGItZjJkZi1lZTExLTg1ZmItMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Gd71eQzcDema6NUMvmn7cGkYambxghtsfO-HK-HgPKQ=)**_

This is our moment of truth. Our fight to protect voting access, LGBTQ+ rights, and reproductive freedom hangs in the balance, and with it, the very essence of our democracy. The stakes could not be higher: we CANNOT afford to lose even a single Senate seat.

Why? Because we have a golden opportunity to not only defend but also expand our Senate majority.

The GOP is doubling down on their MAGA agenda, seeking to strip away fundamental rights piece by piece. Our voting rights, the rights of LGBTQ+ individuals, and the hard-won reproductive freedoms are all on the line. Their strategy is clear: erode our democracy from the inside out.

But here's the truth – their strategy only works if we let it. We have the power to counteract their efforts, to shore up our defenses and go on the offensive. This work requires resources, determination, and most importantly, your unwavering support.

That’s why we’re humbly asking today: can we count on you to join us in this critical moment? Your donation today could be the difference between advancement and regression, between hope and despair. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dr-senate-2402?refcode=DR_EM_FR_90DO_240216_1_1&amount=15]

Thank you,

clean_body: | | | Friend, While serving in Congress, I’ve noticed that we could use a lot more conservative veterans in government. For those of you who don’t know me, my name is John James. I’m a Ranger-qualified Apache helicopter pilot and an unapologetic conservative, and I’m on a mission to save America from Joe Biden and the radical Left. In the Army, there’s no “I.” EVERYTHING you do is for your team. EVERYTHING you do is for your country. It’s a mindset most career politicians couldn’t even IMAGINE adopting. But veterans aren’t politicians. We’re leaders, and we don’t know any different than putting service over self. When I was serving our country, I knew that what my fellow solider looked like or where they came from didn’t matter. The only things we were focused on were keeping the Homeland safe and defeating terrorists. These “divisions” the woke Left wants to force onto us don’t matter when you’re in combat. The radical Democrat’s divisive rhetoric makes us weaker as a military, as a community, and as a country. And that’s EXACTLY what they want. All the radical Left cares about is power and control, and if we’re going to save America, it’s going to take battle-tested veterans to stop them. Thank you, John James | | | Paid for by John James for Michigan John James for Michigan P.O. Box 628 St. Clair Shores, MI 48080 Email sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com by John James for Michigan

A few months ago I reached out to you about a massive issue here in California: mega wildfires. Remember the scary orange skies in San Francisco? The deadly Camp Fire in Paradise? Megafires are one of the greatest risks our beautiful state faces. And yet the past few years I’ve had to fight tooth and nail to help our wildland firefighters get the pay they deserve. **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80776676/460347856/1387576770?&refcode=E7445-20240311-Firefighters-Image-EnvironmentClimate&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNmZhNDg1Y2MtZjRkZi1lZTExLTg1ZmItMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=iDI-zJS-PXenjXmPp51WgmQrBPzrNe3m-DOgQR__jOU=)****Federal wildland firefighters often live in remote areas for weeks at a time, expose themselves to hazardous smoke, and endure temperatures of over 1,300 degrees - all while working up to 18 hours a day! They are also 12 times more likely to commit suicide than the general public because of the serious mental health burden the job takes.** That’s why I found it so crazy that some of our federal wildland firefighters were only earning $11.86 an hour - less than California’s minimum wage of $15. I believe the least we can do is to make sure these heroes and their families are receiving a livable wage. So I worked with the Biden Administration and we passed a significant pay raise for our firefighters in 2021. But this year, Republicans were threatening to let this pay raise expire - which would have effectively given our firefighters a giant pay cut. It is estimated that up to 50% of our wildland firefighters would have left the force - right before another brutal wildfire season coming this summer. **I’m glad to share that this past week I was able to negotiate an extension of this pay raise in the recent government spending bill we passed. Thankfully, we will avert a major crisis that would have left us without the firefighters we needed in 2024.** I know Congress is so dysfunctional these days that it can be hard to celebrate the little wins that mean a big deal to people’s lives, but this is one of those moments! I’ve personally been fighting for this issue for years and I’m glad to see we can make a bit of a difference for these brave men and women who take on the extreme temperatures to keep our communities safe. subject: BIG news, Peter. Thanks to you, President Biden is taking action to limit soot pollution.
body:
Our movement is making our voices heard and driving change. |
---

** **
|
DEVELOPING -- the Biden-Harris administration just finalized new protections against deadly soot pollution. **This is _huge_ news, Peter, and a hard-won victory for our movement.**

Last year, more than 47,000 LCV members wrote to the Biden-Harris administration to demand action to limit soot pollution and clean up the air we breathe. **We overcame fierce opposition from corporate polluters, proving -- once again -- just how powerful our movement can be when we join together to demand a better future for people and our planet.**

This is an incredible victory for communities put at risk by deadly pollutants. Let's show the White House that we appreciate all of their work to combat soot pollution, and urge them to continue finalizing clean air regulations that prioritize public health. [Please write to President Biden and EPA Administrator Regan today to thank them for taking action to combat soot pollution. It only takes a moment to add your name and make your voice heard >>](https://links.messages.lcv.)

More than 20 million Americans experience dangerous levels of soot pollution each year. **These new protections will bring relief to communities of color and low-wealth communities,** which too often experience disproportionate health impacts due to exposure to soot pollution from power plants, industry, and heavy traffic.

These new protections cut the annual limits for soot pollution by a quarter and are a giant step forward. We're urging the Biden-Harris administration to work quickly with states and local air districts to implement these much-improved standards and bring relief to frontline communities, while also using every other tool possible to cut other health-harming and climate pollution.

**These victories don 't happen on their own, Peter. They happen because people like you _demand_ a better future for our communities and our planet.**

Thanks to you, we're making our voices heard and driving _real change_ in Washington, D.C. This latest victory follows the Biden administration's historic announcement, just weeks ago, pausing new exports of climate-killing liquefied methane gas.

I hope you'll take a moment to let your leaders know you're paying attention to these important regulations, and continue to urge action on air pollution. [Sign your name today to thank President Biden and his administration for taking action to limit deadly soot pollution >>](https://links.messages.lcv.)

Thanks for standing with us. We'll be in touch soon with more ways you can make a difference for people and our planet.

Onward,

Matthew Davis

League of Conservation Voters |

Happy Women's History Month, Peter!
As we celebrate the impact that women have made in every facet of our lives — we must also be honest, and ask ourselves if our current society truly supports women from all backgrounds.
We’re just three months into the new year, and Republicans have pushed for unconscionable anti-choice legislation that completely negates the safety, bodily autonomy, and wellbeing of women across the country.
**This Women’s History Month, we must reaffirm our collective commitment to undoing legislative harms against women, not only in our own communities but in communities that look like ours globally.**

subject: Thank you
body:
|
---
| |
---
| | Peter,

All the votes have not yet been counted, but the decision of Orange County voters is clear. I respect their choice.

I am beyond grateful to my supporters, my team and my family for the tireless hours they poured into our campaign over the past year and for the faith and trust they put in me. It has been an honor of a lifetime to fight for them, represent our community, and talk openly about the issues that really matter. Every living room gathering, every door knock, every phone call, and every coffee in the park was worth it. I loved every minute of campaigning for a better Orange County and could not have done it without the thousands I met along the way.

We did not have the deep pockets and outside establishment support of our opponents, but we built a serious campaign fueled entirely by grassroots voters in Orange County. While we came up short, the results show that the grassroots voters are sick and tired of the status quo in Washington and hungry for bold leadership to represent us in Congress and locally.

I called Scott Baugh this past weekend to congratulate him on advancing to the general election and I hope he wins in November. The road to an America First Republican majority in Congress runs through our District. We have to elect strong conservative leaders up and down the ballot in Orange County and across the country. Our community and country are worth fighting for. Do not relent.

As for me, I am looking forward to soon taking on what will be the greatest opportunity of my lifetime: being a Dad. Thank you and God bless you.

\- Max Ukropina

According to reports, Chinese-built cargo cranes in use at American ports had communications equipment installed that did not seem to have an obvious purpose and weren’t requested by the cranes’ owners. Could there be a logical explanation for this? Possibly. But when you have a pattern of concerns about espionage—as the company ZPMC [does](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=1b78b8a22bd44e30b4eca42b0419cedd&_e=z82DjqO1ymWddbbS6UqQMumAwRSFnsG-06PvOiMHiLHGKULy0BvTyL_I8xmch63jBwldC5FdUQBo83cwspq-NdQG6E9FAjw_Fwx0MI1TX_osQ52ms9puI18F771bNbyqJ7QFERXIG9QEduwUbfkBJvSosy7tPjBKNBcD0bkZVTWpSwtmB8-H0iTNsJICcXpugeY4rMcRAg2BvshjJfJr4jz4ALBxMs4mudJ5m2jgd3uKEYaV0mxFXxLyFOqJktoi5NYUoP5lPGmzfHM0jNE-cOpiqGjwg6GFj-Rd6tL7G3ifvyIgJ3CYAt1c87Sjih5u-skQ21K_u7OCu2-Tt_mHxLX5XszrcURKtbxRxncoca8%3D)—and the Chinese Communist Party’s intelligence efforts against America are as [pervasive](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=1b78b8a22bd44e30b4eca42b0419cedd&_e=z82DjqO1ymWddbbS6UqQMjpECac2dwUWDNZMOk6F5P_JH6BBZB8zFKo-m_jK-jcwLwq7uLT1jeZV9KUxBlNHHL2A5DuQ2r1kYofkOIoDPtKpjH-osYqf02ydTIZcgrsW0BoZu0_Ax5CdxL2FV6UMoS2M5hnT_xgtx8DT9i2w-OIFpeolTnRu7oH-g3lHCiStb3CfMdVxXjt_euOX09mfc-4MYBth8YqODAafKIg4YHftrubjQdudtTZuyogt0iUf) as we know them to be, I’m going to go out on a limb and say that these devices aren’t free upgrades for the cranes.

Hello,
When my husband Adam Frisch ran against Lauren Boebert in 2022, we were the underdogs until the very end.
Adam did not receive any national support. We were heavily out-raised and out-spent by Boebert and her Washington allies.
Ultimately, though, Adam lost to Lauren Boebert in a recount by just 546 votes – the closest race in the entire country.
The worst part is that it wasn’t because we didn’t work hard. Our family, our team, and our volunteers gave it everything we had. We just ran out of money.
In the final weeks of the race, we had to cut back. Right as Boebert was increasing her advertising – right as we _knew_ we were on her heels – we had to pull TV ads, cancel digital buys, and make a lot of hard budget decisions.
Adam might not say it, but I will: If we had had additional resources and been able to fully fund his campaign until the end, Adam would probably be in Congress right now – and Lauren Boebert would be a footnote in a history book.
It’s part of why Adam announced so early that he was running again. We need to make sure that we have the money to build a campaign that can sustain all the way through to November 5, 2024.
But with Lauren Boebert having run off scared, this race is now going to be a lot harder. The Super PACs are already attacking Adam, and he’s not taking any money from corporate PACs. If he is going to win this critical seat, Adam needs grassroots donors like you to chip in right now:

clean_body: Adam might not say it, but I will. Hello, When my husband Adam Frisch ran against Lauren Boebert in 2022, we were the underdogs until the very end. Adam did not receive any national support. We were heavily out-raised and out-spent by Boebert and her Washington allies. Ultimately, though, Adam lost to Lauren Boebert in a recount by just 546 votes – the closest race in the entire country. The worst part is that it wasn’t because we didn’t work hard. Our family, our team, and our volunteers gave it everything we had. We just ran out of money. In the final weeks of the race, we had to cut back. Right as Boebert was increasing her advertising – right as we knew we were on her heels – we had to pull TV ads, cancel digital buys, and make a lot of hard budget decisions. Adam might not say it, but I will: If we had had additional resources and been able to fully fund his campaign until the end, Adam would probably be in Congress right now – and Lauren Boebert would be a footnote in a history book. It’s part of why Adam announced so early that he was running again. We need to make sure that we have the money to build a campaign that can sustain all the way through to November 5, 2024. But with Lauren Boebert having run off scared, this race is now going to be a lot harder. The Super PACs are already attacking Adam, and he’s not taking any money from corporate PACs.
